The girls live ordinary school lives, while occasionally performing their duties, wielding their swords and using various powers to fight and protect the people.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

100572.description:
In order to find the missing children, the vampire hunter Ronaldo came to the castle of the supposedly invincible vampire and True Ancestor, Draluc. However, Draluc's true identity was the weakest vampire ever, constantly dying and turning to dust at the slightest provocation!

(Source: Emaqi)
synonyms: The Vampire Dies in No Time

title.english: The Vampire Dies in No Time

title.native: むすんで、ひらかないで

100574.description: Aoi lives with his deceased lovers son, Shio and after one late morning of working, Aoi finds a lonesome puppy on the road. However, the puppy tries to escape and Aoi follows it. The puppy brings him to a mysterious place where he meets a very mysterious man.

title.native: ハマった俺が悪いのか!?
title.romaji: Hamatta Ore ga Warui no ka!?

100576.description:
1-2. Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu no Neko:

In Gensei, where the ghosts reside, a beautiful bartender and his partner, a black cat named Gin, operate a bar. Amongst those visiting the bar was Natsu (a mythical twin-tailed cat), who makes a living reporting gossip. Despite this, he lives a life in poverty.
One day, he meets a widely popular pornographer, Hyde (Tsuchigumo). While hoping to do a scoop exposing Hyde's mysterious private life, Natsu sneaks in as a housekeeper. However, where he thought he would find a story, he instead finds his own body exposed through punishment with catnip and adult toys――?

3. Kochira ga Shin Sekai no Iriguchi desu
4-5. Yoiyami to Kuroneko to Boku no Kishi
6. Watashi no Shin Sekai e Youkoso
synonyms: Kochira ga Shin Sekai no Iriguchi desu
Yoiyami to Kuroneko to Boku no Kishi

title.native: 飛んで火に入る夏のネコ
title.romaji: Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu no Neko

100577.description:
A story of unrequited love between Takashi and his highschool friend Hayate, who rejected his feelings but then promised to go on a date with him for his birthday every year until Takashi finds somebody he likes more than him. Hayate has diligently kept his promised for ten years, but Takashi, still painfully in love with him after all these years, has reached the point where he cannot go on with these yearly meetings.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Namida" (涙).

100578.description:
The owner of a flower shop and the owner of a liquor store get married. This results in Chiaki and Mine becoming stepbrothers. Despite being in the liquor business, Mine can't handle alcohol and gets drunk quite easily. How will Chiaki take advantage of Mine's drunken adventures?

Includes two Rule Sono Ichi side stories.

100579.description:
Izumi likes two things: sweets and a boy in another class at his high school, Ibuki. Ibuki marches to the beat of his own drum, which Izumi admires. However, Izumi is approached by Ibuki's twin, Satsuki! His playboy vibe instantly turns Izumi off, but Satsuki is persistent! Flashforward, and Ibuki thinks Satsuki is dating Izumi... That's when it happens... Ibuki hisses, "I hate gays." Also included is a love story which centers around the two versatile young men, Rio and Etsu, from "Rule Number One".

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: If You Share A Kiss With Asakawa

title.native: 朝川くんとキスをするなら
title.romaji: Asakawa-kun to Kiss wo Suru Nara

100580.description:
1-2. Kirei na Oniisan ni Horeraremashita. (綺麗なお兄さんに惚れられました。)
Noboru, a part-timer in a convenience store, has someone he wants to be friends with, Mikawa, who was an easy going office worker with a beautiful face. Mikawa would come to the store at a specific time and they became friends little by little. One day, Noboru had to take care of Mikawa, who was only acting drunk and pushed Noboru down to be bedded…?!

3. Eroge kara Koi wa Umareru ka!? (エロゲーから恋は生まれるか!?)
4. Eroge kara Koi wa Umareta ga!? (エロゲーから恋は生まれたが!?)
5. Bokura no Kankei (僕らのカンケイ)
6. Kawaii Anata (かわいいアナタ)
7. Kirei na Oniisan to Sonogo (綺麗なお兄さんとその後)
synonyms: A Beautiful Man Fell In Love With Me

title.native: 綺麗なお兄さんに惚れられました。

100581.description: Kind, charismatic and mystic Taeo and the solitary and mysterious Ho, the two are secretly dating. But then Taeo is confused by Ho's unfamiliar behavior and how different he is from the one he knew. Between two people who are in danger of breaking up. How will these two hearts end up burning dangerously?

100582.description:
I've always had a crush on my childhood friend, but he only regards me as a brother?

I hate liking you, I hate that I can't stop myself from loving you, but I can't stop these feelings from growing.

False friend games, secret bittersweet love, youthful sweetness and pain.

I've always wanted to say this out loud to you: "Hey! I like you!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

100583.description:
Lately, Misaki’s life has taken an odd turn. Going to work has become more difficult. It isn’t because he hates his job. Instead, Misaki is struggling to show his face at work because a brash college student called Kushiro is regularly bruising up his face.

Misaki’s fights with Kushiro should have been normal. A typical jab here, an ordinary bruise there. But, as Kushiro keeps throwing the punches, Misaki realizes he might just like it.

These brawls with Kushiro shouldn’t rouse… Misaki’s inner masochism, right?

(Source: Futekiya)

100584.description:
The everyday life of Nakano, a salaryman working for an exploitative company, is suddenly intruded upon by the Kitsune, Senko-san (800 Years Old - Young Wife). Whether it be cooking, cleaning, or a special service...She'll heal his exhaustion with her tender care.

Note: The main storyline was completed in 91 chapters (12 volumes). Author announced they will continue to draw chapters on an irregular basis.

title.native: 世話やきキツネの仙狐さん

100585.description:
Akito is a high school delinquent who is suffering from nightmares featuring his airhead childhood friend, Ryouta. Akito takes care of Ryouta during the day, but at night in his dreams Ryouta would sadistically blame him, “This is all your fault Acchan…” Will the memories of the past gradually engulf Akitoㅡ?!

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

100586.description:
"Maybe I should have thought harder about whom I ask for help. Perhaps it would have been better to implore god to save me."

That's what Ogiwara thought when he was rescued from a debt by a regular customer from the bar he works at. He pays the debt of Ogiwara's disappeared friend, but what does he want in return?

Note: Includes the one-shot "Hana no Akuta (花の芥)" previously published in the anthology Gokuaku BL (極悪BL), four chapters of "Yakuza-sama to Kemono (ヤクザさまとけもの)", and two extra chapters.

100587.description:
"You're really creepy." On the way home from work, Chika saw a suspicious good-looking man following a woman. When he bravely caught the stalker, not only did the man admit his guilt in such an honest manner, but he seemed to have become attached to Chika... A clingy yet sweet love story between a hot stalker and a soft-hearted young man

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 俺とおまえのストーカー防止法
title.romaji: Ore to Omae no Stalker Boushihou

100588.description:
1. The Treachery of a Pair
2. Ore no Kirai na Tsugaisama
3. Drag Me Down and Pull my Hand
4. Yakenogahara
5. How to Bind a Childhood Friend
6. A Bad Habit of Hospitalism
7. Compulsive Hospitalism
8. Ore no Kirai na Tsugaisama Extra & Afterword

100589.description:
Kanou Hiroto, a high school student, experienced sexual harassment when he was a child which led him to be allergic to men. Due to this, he isolated himself from guys until he met Ohshiro Kei, who approached him without knowing about his allergy to men. Ultimately, Kanou struggles as Ohshiro relentlessly pursues after him. Will Kanou accept this twist of fate to his life?

(Source: SaltyPotatoesTrans)

100590.description:
1-2. Chicken Stalker (チキン・ストーカー)
What should one do, when they are too scared to talk to strangers, but fell in love at first sight? To a guy working at an SM club?!

3. Joou no Okyakusama (女王のお客様)
4. Lucky 31 (ラッキー31)
5. Ano Sora de Kimi to (あの空で君と)
6. Ikumen Days (育メンDAYS)
7. Baka na Inu hodo Kawaii! (バカな犬ほどカワイイ!)
8. Joou no Dannasama (女王の旦那様)

100591.description:
A family misunderstanding leaves Merry and his mother to live on an island away from the city, and away from Merry’s father. Twenty years later, Merry’s mother falls sick, and she asks Su-Ho to help care for them. Believing Su-Ho is his half-brother, Merry can’t understand his aversion to touching. But there’s a family secret yet to be revealed, and Su-Ho is having a hard time keeping himself away from Merry...

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

100592.description: Ayato transfers into a new school, hoping for a fresh start. Sadly for him, the school turns up to be filled with delinquents, and the most feared of them all has his eyes set on him. And it doesn't help, that whenever Ayato accidentally takes off his glasses, everyone around him suddenly becomes completely smitten by him.

100593.description:
When salaryman Yuji's straight crush invites him to his marriage, he decides that now is the time to get super drunk. He knows he falls asleep all alone in his apartment, but why does he vaguely remember someone's hands and mouth on him...and wake up to a very special taste on his tongue? If this is really a ghost, why is this haunting very R18?

(Source: Manga Planet)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: ปีศาจจอมโฉดไม่ปล่อยให้ผมนอน
Le fantôme sadique qui ne me laissait pas dormir

title.english: The Sadistic Ghost Doesn't Allow Me to Sleep
title.native: ドSおばけが寝かせてくれない

100594.description: Masataka takes care of a shire, which houses the 12 spirit animals of the Chinese zodiac. One day he gets a surprising visitor, a young man named Kotarou, who is posessed by the cat spirit, Koma. Their own shrine having been burned down, Kotarou now searches for a new place and ends up on Masataka's doorstep.

100595.description: Shinobu is a very cute and somewhat shy gay, who falls madly in love with his best friend Kenji, who for his misfortune is heterosexual and is about to get married. With this sea of mixed feelings and overcome by sadness, Shinobu attends a gay bar with the objective of finding some casual appointment with another man who makes him forget the grief that happens with his unrequited love, in this place he meets Kou a very handsome man who will change his life ...

title.native: ひなは蜜色の恋にとらわれる
title.romaji: Hina wa Mitsuiro no Koi ni Torawareru

100596.description:
1-4 + Extra:
In the middle of a turf war between the raccoons and the foxes are trapped the rabbits. The rabbits receive a proposal from the divine fox spirits saying that they will protect them if they hand over a beautiful bride. However, since there are no girls of a marriageable age, Rikka (the rabbits’s head son) decides to go talk to the divine foxes. What he did not expect was that the head son of the foxes, Shirou, would fall in love at first sight with him. How will these two opposites get along? Can a fox really love a rabbit?

5-6
A salaryman goes through too much stress in work and ends up addicted to sex. Since women can be problematic, he chooses to go to a gay sex agency. There he meets Haruki, who easily sneaks into his everyday thoughts.

100597.description: Included one-shots: Ouchi ga Ichiban., Kaibutsu no Hitosashi.

title.native: アイドルは天国を知らない。

100598.description:
After helping an unusual kid, Tsukasa’s unrequited love interest Kairi becomes a squirrel. This happens because Tsukasa makes a love request to the mountain god saying, “I want to always be with Kairi”! Now both must stick together and figure out how Kairi can revert back to his human body…

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title.native: いとしのモモンガ彼氏

100599.description:
A gaudy young man named Taiichi, captivated by big boobs, accidentally dented the high-class car of a Yakuza member. In order to pay for repair fees, he ends up having to make a post online, selling himself to prostitution. At the Love Hotel he was called out to, he was met with an unfashionable man with messy hair. However, this lame man told him, “I’ll give you money in exchange for your obedience.” At his wit’s end, Taiichi was prepared to lose his anal virginity, however----…

Also, the slapstick love comedy about a College student who took in a man with an amazing dragon tattoo on his back, and other short stories are compiled together.

100600.description:
Sojun Shiina's as fickle as a cat. He only comes to Arata when he wants to. Arata knows that, yet can't help but reach out his hand...

After three months away, Sojun, a famed guitarist, returns to Arata, editor of a well-regarded music magazine. Despite his talent, Sojun has cut himself off from the Japanese music scene. Unable to settle down, he bounces back and forth between countries, often leaving his longtime lover Arata behind. Arata knows that about Sojun, but can't help wishing he'd come back for good, to stay by his side, hold him and make love with him...

The adult love between these two men flickers between Arata's admiration for Sojun's immense talent, his sense of inferiority, and the freedom and possessiveness that comes from affection.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

100601.description:
On the shrine maiden Sakura’s 17th birthday, the goddess of darkness Konohana Chiruhime appears before her. Chiruhime intends to make Sakura her wife and take her to the divine realm. However, upon learning that “ascending to the divine realm means death as a human,” Sakura decides to remain in the human world for the sake of Ichiki, the boy she loves. Chiruhime witnesses Sakura and Ichiki kissing and becomes enraged, using her divine power to cause people to suddenly collapse and die. Realizing that her romance with Ichiki will lead to many casualties, what will Sakura do—!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: I Want To End The World, Too

title.native: 私も世界を終わらせたい

100602.description:
Shouta is a young rebel who always tries to act tough in front of everyone. After a young boy who resembles his first love, Yukito, moves to his neighborhood, he gains the ability to see ghosts! Shouta quickly falls for his new neighbor who always saves him from supernatural troubles... and never fails to tease him while he's at it. It's a sweet occult romance presented to you by Mano Sakamoto!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The River Styx Lies Between Us
title.native: 三途の川の向こうの君
title.romaji: Sanzu no Kawa no Mukou no Kimi

100603.description:
Minami Yuuya meets an old friend from High School, Suzuka Sougo during a job request. Suzuka Sougo agrees, but at what cost?? Will the old feelings that Minami had come back, or will he be forced into blackmail? How long will these two HATE each other…

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)
synonyms: I’ll Never Meet With Such a Scumbag and an Idiot Like Him Again

title.native: クズでバカには二度と会わない
title.romaji: Kuzu de Baka ni wa Nido to Awanai

100605.description: Akagi, is a regular office worker who comes face to face with one of his former classmates, Ichimori. The two men have a history. Ichimori was the star of his judo club in high school but was forced to stop after an unintentionally inflicted leg injury by Akagi. To be forgiven, Akagi, at the time, had offered him to do whatever he liked?! So, when Ichimori reappears years later by telling him that his girlfriend kicked him out and asking him to temporarily lodge him, Akagi is not entitled to refuse him his help, although he can not help but wonder why Ichimori came back to find him..

title.native: 無人島に持っていくなら

100606.description:
Uchiumi Sunao mistook the identity of "Tama" twice. First he was drunk, thought Tama was a stray cat and picked him up. Next, he thought Tama was a poor omega being forced to sell his body... but he's actually an alpha that just likes having sex! How many more misunderstandings can happen between them?

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.english: I'll Meow For You, So Love Me
title.native: ニャアと鳴くから愛してよ

100607.description:
Young college student Nonohiko is faced with a dilemma: his super-cheap college dorm has been closed down! But, he finally finds an all-male share house. The beautiful landlady (actually a cross-dressing guy) only approves hot men as residents, but Nonohiko somehow manages to meet this strange requirement. Moving day brings a mix of fear and anticipation. A man in fashionable glasses, who lives in the share house, invites Nonohiko into the bath, only to mistake him for someone who provides "special services"...! An innocent rom-com that springs from the personality gap between a flirty, bespectacled CEO and a pure-hearted college student!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: アワーハウスラブトラブル

100608.description:
“Your legs are so extravagant, beautiful and lewd”.

Kurosawa, the Shoefitter, a former exclusive model of the luxury brand “VERGA”, is now responsible for the brand’s main shop in Japan. Such a perfect and elegant man cannot possibly be fixated on an ordinary salaryman like me. But when he suddenly started licking my legs in such an extremely loving way, I could not contain this elevating desire…!

To be tempted by erotic flirtation that can melt him, it is a passionate fetish love.

title.english: Indecent Gentleman of the Fitting Room

100609.description:
"Please no more...Save me, Nakamuraaah...!"

With the stress from work and his girlfriend, Seta's body, mind and spirit are all reaching their breaking point. Then along comes his subordinate--body pillow fanatic--Nakamura, who proposes that they become sleep buddies (friends who sleep next to each other). With his mental state stretched to its limits, he decides to try it; but seriously, with a guy?! Buuut...why does it feel so nice to be enveloped in the strong arms of his brash subordinate?

Includes One Shots: First Bite (ファーストバイト), Katappashi kara Zenbu Ai (片っ端からぜんぶ愛)
Includes Side Stories: Bed wa Futatsu Irimasen (ベッドはふたついりません), Yokuasa no Dekigoto (翌朝の出来事)

100610.description:
He comes undone again and again from Kaito's unrelenting pro technique!!

Kaito Oda, a popular adult film star specializing in man-on-man videos, saves delinquent Ryuji Arikawa from danger in the middle of a fight. But, in return for saving him, Kaito demands that Ryuji act in a video with him where a delinquent gets "trained"!! Against his better judgment, Ryuji appears in the film, but things don't end with just one round!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: Shirouto Yankee Kikiippatsu!! Take 1: Deatte ￮ byō rokkuon!
素人ヤンキー♂危機一発！！ REPLAY
素人ヤンキー♂危機一発！！

title.native: 素人ヤンキー♂危機一発!!

100611.description:
Short comics released on the official Japanese Sonic the Hedgehog website, Sonic Channel, as part of the franchise's 25th anniversary celebrations. Each comic focuses on individual Sonic characters featured in the Character Profiles on Sonic Channel often featuring slice-of-life moments or references to their backstory in past games.

(Source: Sonic Wikia, edited)

100612.description: This is a world where humans and vampire have found something to co-exist: artificial blood. Still, it can't really be helped that people would be scared of vampires because of their dangerous nature. Meanwhile, a man who is tired of loneliness after the death of his lover decided to adopt a vampire child. Of course, he had needs, so he calls for sex service every night. What he didn't know is that the kid sees it, and because the kid drinks his blood, he is growing up too fast. Will the man be able to see this vampire as a grown man when he was just an adorable little child yesterday?

title.native: マイ・リトル・ヴァンパイア

100613.description:
Satonaka Tamami (Tama) has been in love with her childhood friend Tsukimori Masachika (Chika) for 10 years now. Tama first confessed to Chika when she was just six but got turned down. Chika told her that he might consider if they were in high school!

10 years worth of wait is now over and Tama declares to her friends that she is going to confess to Chika. But her friends are worried since Chika is kind of cold and he is in the kendo club that forbids its members from any relationship.

Tama still musters enough courage and asks Chika out. Chika turns her down on the spot. However, seeing how he almost broke his childhood friend's heart, he decides to give her a chance to go out with him but only if she can keep their relationship a secret! Tama is in ecstasy and really looking forward to their relationship but, keeping their relationship a secret might not be as simple as she had thought.

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title.native: スパイスとカスタード

100614.description:
Stories between an older man and a little girl.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

title.native: おっさんと幼女まとめ

100615.description: An anthology comic of Danshi Koukousei no Nichijou by various mangaka.

title.english: Daily Lives of High School Boys Anthology
title.native: 男子高校生の日常アンソロジー

100616.description:
Se Woong became middle-aged without any proper confession to his first love. In his dried up life, Yoo Il, who is brightness and youth himself, appears. But, he is the son of his friend… and that friend of his was Se Woong’s first love.

Note:
- In 2021 the author re-released the series with many revisions bringing the chapter count from 24 to 29.
- Includes two extra chapters.

100617.description:
“I wanna graduate so I don’t have to see him ever again..”

Under the blue sky, Hyun-Woo’s youth spins in a circle. Same class, next seat in the bus, and his bright smile. The smallest things take quite a strain at Hyun-Woo’s heart, seeking for jealousy and dictatorship. Wanting to get closer, but still keeping the distance. Why is love so complicated? As well as today, the distance between Hyun-Woo and Chan-Hee stay the same as ever.

100618.description:
What if you could talk to your favorite fictional character every day? And what if they make you feel like the most special person in the world? “Good morning,” “I was thinking about you,” “Sweet dreams,” “See you tomorrow”... Some fans dive into their TV/movie/book obsessions on social media by interacting with accounts that take on the persona of their favorite characters. But what if the person behind that fictional account is actually...the very star who played that role?

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: 我的SNS专属机器人竟然是男神本尊？

100622.description: In an age long lost to legend and myth. In an age where humans had still yet to establish a system of writing.  It’s said that there existed a Magus in a country named Scarlet. It’s said that he imparted knowledge concerning language and writing, taught how to cultivate the lands, instructed the ways of raising animals, and brought about the gift—nay, the magic of fire. It’s said that he was a dauntless youth, a dragon clad in scarlet red scales, a person worshipped far and wide. It’s said that this man was the God of Civilization. Yet strangely, his name had been virtually wiped from the records. Therefore, he was simply referred to as— —The Magus of Genesis.

100623.description:
Everyone has the potential to fall to "the other side." Meth, marijuana, MDMA... Once you're hooked, there's no turning back. Enter two relentless hounds who chase, expose, and capture all manner of drug crimes. Their profession? Narcotics agents, known as "Matori." Through the investigations of agents Kusakabe and Saeki, this shocking exposé unearths the deep-seated darkness of modern society. Brace yourself for a hard-hitting documentary on drug crime!

(Source: Emaqi)

title.english: Matorism: Case Files of a Narcotics Agent

100626.description:
The story of them happened in such an unexpected place, a mental hospital. To escape from the shadows of childhood, he thought he would hide for the rest of his life. But someone said to him, "I won't pull you out of the shadows, but if you want, I will stay with you in the darkness forever."

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: The author passed away before completing the story, so the artist finished the final chapters alone.

100629.description:
“You’re under arrest!” On his first official assignment, police officer Jinho thinks he catches a flasher... only it’s the suave school nurse, Hwanung! One chance encounter quickly develops into something more as Jinho finds himself both excited and flustered by Hwanung’s gestures of affection. Follow their story in this prequel comic to “Stop at the Red Light.”

(Source: Lezhin)

100630.description:
After only one day's performance in this new village, someone has destroyed Go Jin and his musical troupe's instruments. His search for the culprit leads him to Gam-rae, the Taoist master of the village. Endowed with supernatural gifts, suspicion often falls on him. But Go Jin soon finds that there is much more to this man than his gifts, as he becomes caught in the middle of Gam-rae's own supernatural battle.

(Source: Lezhin)

100631.description: In this manga, we follow Mochizuki Dorao, a regular at the Iisuu Chii parlor (a play on the 1-4-7 suji and the word for the Souzu suit being the same used in "parlor") and a professional gambler who can always win no matter the opponent, as he plays against different opponents and visits different parlors — ones crazier than the previous ones —.

title.native: ぎゅわんぶらあ自己中心派

synonyms: The Hand of God or Devil

100634.description:
A collection of oneshots about monster girls, wives and more!

Volume 1:
1. Heart-wringing Yamanba-sensei by HATTORI Mitsuru
2. The Youth of Haruse, The Dullahan by Rishin
3. An Odd Pair for Life by Amatou
4. Our Mascot Cat by gum
5. Rise up! Mandragora-senpai! by Yugo
6. A Human, a Tiger, and a Wizard by TAKAHO Tadachika
7. I'm Dating a Vampire by KAGA Mitsuki
8. A Life in the Shadow by solopipB

Volume 2:
1. Wankomplex by Mintarou
2. Living with a Fox by Amatou
3. My Sluggish Wife Leannán-san by NISHIZONO Fumiko
4. The Dullahan Haruse and Her Friends by Rishin
5. Legend of the Ogres by HIYAMA Daisuke
The series Peter Grill to Kenja no Jikan was based off of this oneshot.
6. Good Luck, Shitori-chan! by TAKAHO Tadachika
7. Soul-Sucking Demon by Rage
8. The Yearning of the Forgotten Bones by solopipB

title.native: 人外の嫁といちゃいちゃする アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Jingai no Yome to Ichaicha Suru: Anthology Comic

100636.description: One sunny leisurely day, a woman visited my house and asked me if I were interested in managing a dungeon along with support from goddess. But of course, I refused. Eh? Shouldn't I ignore a person in trouble, moreover if it's a beautiful woman? No way! That's too bothersome, and why do I have to do that? I'm perfectly satisfied with my comfortable life now, throwing it away is just overly stupid...... ...sigh, fine, so it's go to another world, become a dungeon master, manage a dungeon and deal with the Mana circulation problem? Understood, but how to do it?
synonyms: The Way to Absolute Dungeon Administration – There Is No Reason To Meet With the Opponent!
必勝ダンジョン運営方法 相手に合わせる理由がない

title.native: 必勝ダンジョン運営方法

100637.description:
Kurt was born to a poor Baron house of Arnold. He was a genius pastry chef in the previous world.

While increasing the wealth of his fief as the feudal lord, he aims for his past unfulfilled dream, to become the greatest pastry chef in the world. Making honey, building orchards with elves, trading, he gathers ingredients for his pastries, those which give a whole new taste never seen before in the different world…

Huge profit from selling special products, extremely high praise from Ducal house as temporary pâtissier, the shop that he builds in the capital city becoming a big hit!

This is a sweet tale of pastries and being surrounded by kind people.

(Source: Futabasha, Novel Updates)
synonyms: Upstart Pastry Chef: Territory Management of a Genius Pâtisserie

title.native: お菓子職人の成り上がり～天才パティシエの領地経営～
title.romaji: Okashi Shokunin no Nariagari: Tensai Pâtisserie no Ryouchi Keiei

100638.description: On the verge of his death, a great sage reincarnated into "Infinite Evolving Slime" which he created with great sorcery. He decided to enjoy his new life, rather, new slime life, but his elf disciple, who is also his adopted daughter, caught and tamed him...

title.native: スライム転生。大賢者が養女エルフに抱きしめられてます
title.romaji: Slime Tensei.: Daikenja ga Youjo Elf ni Dakishimeraretemasu

100639.description: A neet man who died alone in his previous life is reincarnated as Enid, the son of a lord, in a medieval fantasy parallel world where magic exists, and begins to develop a village and live adventures.

title.native: 俺の部屋ごと異世界へ! ネットとAmozonの力で無双する
title.romaji: Ore no Heyagoto Isekai e! Net to Amozon no Chikara de Musou suru

100646.description:
Satou Ryouta who died from overworking at a black company was reincarnated to another world. Although Ryouta was alive, he is now burdened with the inconvenience that his level is fixed to 1 in this new world.

Although he wasn’t able to raise his level, he had a unique skill that can create a cheat-like item that shouldn’t exist in the world from a monster.

He got to know about his status and MAX them with the help of ability-up items. He gathered a number of weapons and items that can only be used by himself, allowing him to be level 1 but yet, having the strongest equipment.
synonyms: Although I Am Only Level 1, but with This Unique Skill, I Am the Strongest

title.english: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP even at Level 1
title.native: レベル１だけどユニークスキルで最強です
title.romaji: Level 1 dakedo Unique Skill de Saikyou desu

synonyms: I do not need cheat in the new game!

title.native: ニューゲームにチートはいらない！
title.romaji: New Game ni Cheat wa Iranai!

100648.description:
I thought I could keep moving forward, but in an unexpected instant, I’ve lost myself in the gaps of this vast universe. Where have I seen this, this landscape that doesn’t exist? Right over there, in a time that will never come to pass. Welcome to the world of panpanya.

The 22 chapters of Makura Uo, which include stories like Ame no Hi (Rainy Day) and Gomi no Sakebigoe (The Cries of Trash), were either serialized in the special web edition of Hakusensha’s Rakuen Le Paradis magazine or published as doujinshi. Included are entries from panpanya’s diary as well as annotations from the author herself.

(Source: Hakusensha & Natalie, translated)

100649.description:
When Hiiragi learns that he has a half-brother he’s never met, he decides to meet the man… but is shocked by what he discovers. Hiiragi’s newfound older brother is inexplicably covered in bandages from head to toe, and runs a mysterious pet shop that sells rare animals. Behind the counter of this strange place is an even more shocking secret: customers in-the-know can rent out yokai creatures to perform supernatural deeds, as long as they’re willing to forge a contract written in blood.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

100650.description: Takumi, a young guy born and raised in an environment filled with welfare, left our world without getting the chance of testing his abilities. Thanks to that regret, he’s granted the opportunity of reincarnating in a new world. In the presence of a Goddess, he decides to “reincarnate in a world where abilities are everything”! After being reincarnated as a slave, he wakes up in cell and starts gathering information from the other children in the room, included a gorgeous elf and a beautiful beastman who will become his comrades. With that, he starts down the path to becoming a slave merchant.
synonyms: A New Game from the Depths of Captivity! ~ Rising from Slavery with Just One's Own Abilities
Saiteihen Kara Nyuu Geemu! ~ Aete Dorei Ni Natte Isekai Wo Jitsuryoku Dake De Nukeagarimasu

title.native: 最底辺からニューゲーム! ~あえて奴隷になって異世界を実力だけで駆け上がります
title.romaji: Saiteihen Kara New Game!: Aete Dorei Ni Natte Isekai Wo Jitsuryoku Dake De Nukeagarimasu

100651.description: Aldred, the leader of a kingdom’s A-ranked party, "Black silver" has accomplished the task of slaying a dragon. However, he who has pursued strength his whole life has lost sight of his goal from taking down a monster of the strongest species. As he worried about what to do next in his life, it was the scenery of Nordende that popped up in his mind; A rural village by the countryside, full of natural beauty, which he only visited once during a quest in the past. After declaring the disbandment of his party, he heads towards Nordende for a comfortable, relaxing life.

title.native: Aランク冒険者のスローライフ
title.romaji: A Rank Boukensha no Slow Life

100660.description:
Kazuyoshi Ishii, the founder of the martial arts organization K-1, had been sent to prison for tax evasion. After serving his sentence, he exits Shizuoka Prison only to be immediately killed by a speeding truck and reincarnated in the body of Kei Ichinose—a comatose high school girl?! Twenty years since the genesis of K-1, the MMA world’s problem solver now inhabits the body of a schoolgirl and comes to grips with the karate he left behind in this story of youthful spirit and determination.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

100662.description:
Just when Yeonduk thought he was finally going to be free of his tormentor (and family friend and crush, might we add), Seo Skyler – coolest kid in school – saunters his way into the same classroom. Skyler might look blessed (his sister’s even in a girl group), but he’s got some family issues that only Yeonduk can understand. Yeonduk is more than just star-struck, though, and when Skyler starts acting nice and walking to school with him, he can’t help but hope there might finally be more between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

100664.description:
Nagatoro is a freshman in high school who loves teasing and torturing her older male classmate! What’s her motivation and why does Senpai put up with her? Does Nagatoro just want to create misery for Senpai? Or maybe she secretly likes him?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes 35 extra chapters.
synonyms: Nie drocz się ze mną, Nagatoro!
ยัยตัวแสบแอบน่ารัก นางาโทโระ

title.english: Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro
title.native: イジらないで、長瀞さん

100669.description: "Don’t give up without trying, accept the challenge!" Unmotivated high school student Noda Kouta decides to abide by his father’s teachings and tackle the things in front of him. He accepts the confession of Kasamura Sou from the soccer club. Although he is surprised by the confession made by someone of the same sex, he likes spending time with the gentle Sou. He boldly accepts kissing and sex, but…!?
synonyms: On Teachings of the Noda Family

100670.description:
Love is a battlefield.

For years, a great war has raged on between the scientifically advanced Empire and a paradise of witches known as the Nebulis Sovereignty. This age-old battle sets the scene for a fateful encounter between two young combatants: an imperial swordsman, Iska, and the witch princess, Aliceliese. As sworn enemies, they vow to cut each other down in order to unite their worlds, and yet Iska finds himself entranced by her beauty and righteousness, while Aliceliese is moved by his strength and resolve. In the midst of a never-ending war that forbids them from being together, they have no choice but to destroy each other—or can they find another way?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Our War that Ends the World. or Perhaps the Crusade that Starts it Anew
The Last Battlefield Between You and I. or Perhaps the Beginning of the World's Holy War
ศึกสุดท้ายของเธอกับผมคือจุดเริ่มต้นของโลกใบใหม่
Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen

title.english: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World
title.native: キミと僕の最後の戦場、あるいは世界が始まる聖戦
title.romaji: Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Arui wa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen

100671.description:
There was a world where "Golems," magical humanoids, were created to obey their owners' commands to help people.
Lemmeck, the arcanist, and his son, Noah, were always being shunned by the townspeople in their small town for a certain reason...
A kind, passionate, and heartwarming golem fantasy is born!!

(Source: Shonen Jump.com)
Note: Vol. 2 includes the oneshot

100672.description:
Voice actor otaku Suzuna meets a boy with the ideal handsome voice, Tachibana Waku. She wants to get friendly with him but Waku is acting cold...

"So heart melting you can't help but smile!" A younger tsundere boy and a girl obsessed with him scenes o’ plenty! Whispering sweet nothings, tin-can phones, handsome voices, loaded with moe situations! Settled firmly in the first position of comico novel category, continuously receiving good reviews and high praises from its readers. Now it’s time to raise the curtain on this youthful love started with a voice!
synonyms: Does this voice have a fee?

title.native: そのボイス、有料ですか？

100674.description:
When the Earth is threatened by the sudden appearance of undead creatures, a group of young women blessed with powers from a mysterious source rose to defeat them. Now, after three years of apparent peace, the same malevolent creatures have resurfaced. Five magical girls are once again conscripted to war as the Magical Girl Special-Ops force, to defend mankind from an unholy nemesis!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: หน่วยปฏิบัติการพิเศษสาวน้อยเวทมนตร์ อาสึกะ

title.native: 魔法少女特殊戦あすか

100676.description:
Kusunoki Mebuki was up to compete for the hero's position, but lost to Karin Miyoshi. This left a jealous stain on the girl. She was later summoned to Kagawa's Gold tower, where she was given a new duty as a sentinel, a soldier whose job is to stand by and keep watch. Now along with three other sentinels and a priestess, Mebuki will fight and protect her army, the current generation of heroes, and the rest of humanity from the creatures who hide behind the wall.

(Source: Yuki Yuna is a Hero Wikia)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Kusunoki Mebuki wa Yuusha de Aru

100677.description:
After a certain man open his eyes, he saw an unfamiliar scenery in front of him and his whole body was a strange green. No matter how you look at it, that appearance was the green monster, ‘goblin’.

“I can’t even remember my name but i am a human!!”

That guy who happened to extend his life after encountering the adventure (human), accepted the fact that he was a goblin and began living with the name of ‘Goblio’

He didn’t even have any cheating skill! He couldn’t understand human language! It was a goblin life in hard mode!

After arriving in a goblin village, he was lucky to have met a reliable partner (goblin & orc) and Goblio began getting used to living.

But, during the time when the goblin from the village wanted to assault a human girl, his former human justice and courage sprung out and he saved the girl! Due to this accident, he lost his place and even the important partner—!?

The chapter of the high tension fantasy of a guy who was reborn as a goblin and writhing in agony to become a human began now!

“That’s right, I’m not gonna die… since I am a goblin after all…!”

100678.description:
After overworking himself in the city, Nagisa returns back to the small fishing village he once called home. A place filled with painful memories and regret becomes all too real as his childhood friend, Kaito, shows up at his home. There was a reason Nagisa left his hometown in the first place and the last person he wanted to see was Kaito. Even after all these years, Nagisa's feelings have remained the same, hiding just beneath the surface. After the tragic events that unfolded in this little fishing village, can Nagisa and Kaito find closure? Or will memories of the past hinder their future?

(Source: Juné Manga)

100679.description:
A story set 30,000 years ago, starring the Cro-Magnon, by the duo behind Kami-sama no Iu Toori.

The story follows Akuu, the Cursed Child, born during the night of a blood moon, said to bring calamity upon all, and his attempt to fight destiny.

100680.description: The thing Hara Dai hates the most is people. To him, every single person is troublesome. He was bullied and bothered so much throughout middle school that he debuted as a delinquent in high school. However, whether he's plain or flashy, it seems the only person who isn't bothersome is the janitor.
synonyms: Kirei ni Shite yo: Another Side

100681.description:
Based on a Novel "Without Reservations" ("With or Without" series vol1.):

Sometimes love just catches you by the tail.

Chayton Winston is a veterinarian. He is also a werewolf. Much to his Native American parent's chagrin, he has always dreamed of a fair-haired, Caucasian mate. However, he never imagined his mate would be male. As a heterosexual man, he's not quite sure what to do with a male mate, but more than willing to find out.

Keaton Reynolds wakes up, in wolf form, and finds himself with a mate. He's instantly attracted, but not so thrilled to find out the man is straight. Having been in a relationship once before where his partner professed to be "Not gay" left a bad taste in his mouth. Keaton wants to make a break for it and pretend he never set eyes on Chay-but Chay is not ready to let him go.

Together the two work to solidify their shaky relationship and battle the prejudices against homosexuals. Chay must deal with not only his mother's prejudices against gay men but also her hatred of white people.

When Keaton's life is threatened, the two men learn to depend on one another and their relationship to get them through it.

100682.description:
Bo-Eun has recently acquired a furry little roommate named Dallae (Korean for azalea), who she met in an azalea field. Dallae has her own schedule, though, and comes and goes as she pleases. Meanwhile, Bo-Eun can’t seem to stop dreaming about a missed friendship in high school – her name is Sae-Yeon. Oddly enough, it was around the time that Dallae started showing up that Bo-Eun started having recurring dreams of Sae-Yeon...

This story has two (or is it three?) main characters, and they’re all hiding a secret from each other.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Won the 3rd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest.

100683.description:
Jaime finds himself alone in the world after his grandmother passes, and so does Percy. So when Jaime moves to a new neighborhood, Percy makes sure to follow the only thing he has left in the world... Only Jaime doesn’t know who Percy is. The two soon learn that their lives are even more intertwined than either ever knew. Along the way, they meet Jessica, the erotic thriller novelist with three cats, and Noland, a former colleague of Jaime’s who apparently dropped out. And after meeting Jessica’s cats, Percy learns he has a special gift: he speaks Yumyum, the language of Yummies (aka hoomans).

(Source: Lezhin US)

100685.description:
The young man Cole dreams of one day joining the holy clergy and departs on a journey from the bathhouse "The Spice and Wolf Inn," owned by his savior, Lawrence. The Winfiel Kingdom's prince has invited him to help correct the sins of the church. But as his travels begin, Cole discovers in his luggage a young girl with a wolf's ears and tail named Myuri who stowed away for the ride!

In the past, Cole had accompanied the Wise Wolf Holo and the traveling merchant Lawrence on their own wanderings, eventually growing up alongside their daughter, Myuri as siblings. But as Cole prepared to set off, Myuri opposed his departure and so she secretly ran away from home to join him!

This is the story of Wolf and Parchment, and the pair's travels that will someday change the world!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: 新說 狼與辛香料 狼與羊皮紙

title.english: Wolf & Parchment: New Theory Spice & Wolf
title.native: 新説 狼と香辛料 狼と羊皮紙
title.romaji: Shinsetsu Ookami to Koushinryou: Ookami to Youhishi

100687.description:
Fate Graphite has never tasted real power. Born with the magical skill Gluttony, he constantly hungers in a way that can’t be satiated, and has been shunned and looked down upon his entire life. One day, while working as a gatekeeper for a noble family and fighting a trespassing thief, he discovers Gluttony’s true power: when he kills someone, he devours their skills and feeds his gnawing hunger at last. In that grisly realization, Fate is awakened to his true potential. How many lives will he feed on to satisfy this hunger, and is the world ready for the frightening warrior he’ll become?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes five extra chapters
synonyms: Glutton Berserk: The One That Exceeds The Concept Of Levels
จอมตะกละดาบคลั่ง: ข้านี่แหละจะทะลวงแนวความคิดที่เรียกว่าเลเวลเอง

title.native: 暴食のベルセルク　～俺だけレベルという概念を突破する～
title.romaji: Boushoku no Berserk: Ore dake Level to Iu Gainen wo Toppa Suru

100689.description:
St Dorothea's Academy is a prestigious all girls' school with top scores and rich history. It's famed for the strong bonds which the students share with each other, known for being eternal.

Every year, two friends with the closest bond are chosen to represent the school and guide their fellow students. They are known as "Les Reines du Printemps".

With flowers being scattered, a game of friendship and betrayal starts...

100690.description: Shinomiya Rui is a new high school teacher who loves connecting to her students. Rui Hayase, a student with the same name, will not open up his mind so easily to her. One day, Rui is found shoplifting, instructed by his father to do so. The reason for this is...?!

title.native: from End～自由という名の妄想と殺意～
title.romaji: from End: Jiyuu to Iu Na no Mousou to Satsui

100691.description: In a small alleyway in Higashiyama, Kyoto, there are two boarding houses, and in the alley these form, dubbed "outcast alleyway," there are only two tenants. So one of them, the daughter of the current landlord, pesters the other tenant into helping her gather more residents, specifically other outcasts.

100692.description: The children of Usui and Misaki met a boy in Kyoto and oversaw some strange miracles there.

100693.description:
It's been ten years since Rentt Faina, a down-on-his luck Bronze-class adventurer, set his eyes on becoming Mithril-class. Unfortunately, Rentt finds himself helpless when confronted by a legendary Dragon in the Labyrinth of the Moon's Reflection...and is summarily eaten. But Rentt has miraculously reawakened...as a Skeleton?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: เส้นทางพลิกผันชองราชันอมตะ

100694.description: Two women who went to the same high school (but didn't know each other) meet by chance. One a former literature student from a plain group, who's a freelancer now, and the other a former idolized prince in high school, who's a beautiful office lady now.

100695.description: On a rainy day, a little girl, Kazuha, gets lost in the mountain. She encounters Ichiyo, a fox, and gradually become friends. Together, they take a peek at his brother's wedding.

100697.description: Hasuo Tsukinari is lonely high school student. He hates school and thinks of it as a prison. After getting involved in an incident with his literature teacher Ai Iruma, he was forced to be a 'white mouse' in her experiments to study about love.

title.native: アイ先生はわからない

100699.description:
Keimusho no Mae was written after the author was released from the prison; and is not a direct prequel to Keimusho no Naka.

It is a fictitious compilation of 3 intertwined stories—author's record detailing restoration of a gun, an old tale taking place in medieval Japan of a girl that embarks into a journey to seek happiness, and a detailed diary of the time in prison.

100700.description:
This is a collection of some of Hanawa's early ero-guro work, mainly from the 70's.

1. Niku-yashiki (肉屋敷)
2. Ennyuu (怨乳)
3. Enjuu (怨獣)

100701.description:
"Could you please let me watch you masturbate!?" Romance novelist Rio's struggling to write a young adult erotic novel. From what her agent says, her writing "has no sex appeal"... After some careful deliberation, she begs Mr. Fujishima, a cute banker she just happened to meet, to let her interview him about his sexual encounters. Fujishima doesn't look happy... In fact, he never looks happy, and yet, he can't help indulging her and softening a little at her straightforward authenticity... Rio feels so grateful to Mr. Fujishima for agreeing to "show" her how to have sex!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 教えてください、藤縞さん！

100702.description: The protagonist is a girl with the ability to visit a surreal alternate dimension full of monsters in her dreams. One day, she encounters another human girl there and receives a plea for help.

100703.description: On the distant island where Yotsuwa Private Girl's Acadamy is located, the Near-Extinct Car Academic Faculty takes old barn finds and restores them and their owner's memories. Following her dream of driving her late grandfather's Subaru Sambar, Rico Momose and her freshman friends join the Rare Car Class to bring back to life these old, forgotten vehicles and their legacies. Follow Rico and her friends' journey as they make plenty of car-related memories.
synonyms: Zesshaka - Shiritsu yottsu wa Joshigakuin zetsumetsu kigu-sha gakka
Zessyakka - Private Yotsubashi Girls' Academy Department for Endangered cars

100704.description:
Uramichi is 31. Uramichi appears on children’s TV alongside two grown men dressed as forest creatures and a singing woman with a very short fuse. Uramichi leads little kids in exercises and answers their questions about life. But Uramichi’s life is pain. Uramichi just wants to be miserable in peace. But, in his words, “There are games that don’t end even after you forfeit. Like life, for example…”

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: The English edition volumes are omnibuses combining two Japanese volumes into one English volume.

100705.description: The Republic of Torimania. The only place in the world where winged humans live. The capital is Torima. The official language is Japanese. Their famous product is bird manju. A young girl chooses this mysterious country for her studies abroad. Who will she encounter in the Republic of Torimania, and what will she find there?

100706.description:
The "lovely" daily life between an idol and his pro hater!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Finally Living Together with My Anti-Fan

100708.description:
Tianyu Lin is the leader of the student council's Discipline department. Meanwhile, Ze Xu is a new first year senior high student. During a routine inspection, Tianyu discovers someone sleeping in the last row near the window. He walked over and have him a demerit. Who knew that this demerit would result in them giving their lives to each other...

(Source: WebComics)

100709.description:
Season 1:
Ye Zi seems like a delinquent, but he's really a sensitive crybaby scarred by domestic violence. His childhood playmate Gao Hang had lost his parents when he was young. When they met again, Ye Zi wanted to be friends like their childhood days, only to be rejected by Gao Hang. Can they reconcile their emotions, and find the happiness that have been missing from their lives?

Season 2:
The loner Lu Qian poured all his emotions into music. One day, he met up with his online songwriting partner Su Ci. Two people with different backgrounds and opposite personalities grow closer to each other as they spend more time together.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

100710.description:
Moon Crystal Cosmetics is winning the hearts of female customers everywhere- with its all-male team of cute, hot makeup artists! When GoEun joins this forbidden space as the first girl employee, strange events and a mystery man start giving her trouble! Where's my worker's compensation, my witness protection plan?!!

(Source: TappyToon)

title.native: ドカベン ドリームトーナメント編

100713.description: An amazing baseball player by the name of Keijirou Okamoto enters a high school that cancelled its baseball club 3 years ago due to its lack of success. After hearing this, Keijirou is determined to revive the baseball club by gathering students from other clubs including the tennis and track and field club. He not only wants to make a team, but wants to make it to the Koushien.

100724.description:
Hayasaka Ryuka is a junior high school second grader. She did not get along well with the inner junior high school, leaving her parents and living in Setonai where her grandmother lives. One day, when Rika asked for an object picked up in the sea, a variant similar to a figurine appeared. This is the Lucky God ...!?

Note: Nominated for the 10th Manga Taishou Awards (2017).

100730.description:
Inaba Suzuna is trying her best to make a campus debut and to have many friends in Tokyo. Until she realized that she miserably fails at living alone. Fortunately, her neighbor, Seto-kun, comes and saves her from dying of starvation. Bright campus life is still far away for Suzuna, but at least, she has a very dependable neighbor!

A manga about easy cooking with heartwarming story in every chapter

Includes ch. 0.

title.native: トナリはなにを食う人ぞ
title.romaji: Tonari wa Nani wo Kuu Hito zo

100731.description: Nao, a university student who lives with his childhood otaku friend, Subaru. Upon receiving rejections of hanging out with his female friends, Nao decided to pick up girls instead. Charmed by her smile, he succeeded. Only exception was that the girl he dated for a day, Azusa, turned out to be a guy. Their relationship progressed smoothly until Subaru stepped in. How will their relationship continue?

title.native: 溺れるトライアングル

100732.description:
I, Ichinosuke, failed to get a job for 100 consecutive times. Furthermore, my record is still being updated as unemployed.

On my way to a job interview, I was involved in an accident with a truck and tragically passed away.

And then, a Goddess bestowed upon me the ability to grow at a speed 400 times faster than normal, before sending me to a game-like otherworld.

However, knowing that I would not become stronger even if I continued growing while jobless, I aimed to get a job, but I found out that it was my terrible fate to remain jobless.

As my Growth Cheat and Jobless Cheat existed side-by-side in this otherworld, an adventure record, no doubt certified by the job-placement agency as a harmful book, begins here.

but I Can't Seem to Get out of Being Jobless

100742.description:
I quit my job, became a voice actor, and drastically changed my looks — all to catch the attention of dreamy Jaehyun from work. But he doesn’t know I’m me! What he does know is that I dub his favorite animation, and adores the way I sound. On top of that, now he’s moved in next door too?! A perfect chance for neighborly love!

(Source: TappyToon)

100743.description: "Is it friendship? Is it love? I just want to become someone special to you..."

100746.description:
“I like you, but I don’t want to lose our friendship...” Hae-in finds it harder and harder to suppress his feelings for his good friend and roommate, Min. It doesn’t help that Min is a natural flirt who likes to tease Hae-in every chance he gets. These two make an adorable will-they-won't-they couple! The sequel to "See You at the Crosswalk."

(Source: Lezhin)

100747.description:
Eunsuk and Jung-gu have a complicated relationship. The easiest way to describe it would be "roommates." Of course, not all roommates have sex. And most of them don't visit bathhouses together. And only a small few of them have sex at bathhouses.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

100750.description:
Possessed of aristocratic blood but bereft of money, the impoverished Baron Miharco travels the galaxy in search of his ideal woman, attended by his robot valet Lampachika.

This is the ballad of his itinerant travels, and of the adventures that await him!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: A Interstellar Voyage Fit for a Baron

title.native: 男爵にふさわしい銀河旅行

100751.description: Hiroshiman boy Onijiro Otogi, and Russian girl Paulina are a newly-wed couple in their third year of high school. Together, they will learn about proper physical relations as they raid their high school life!

title.native: 学び生きるは夫婦のつとめ
title.romaji: Manabi Ikiru wa Fuufu no Tsutome

100753.description: Shina Ayumu is part of what other college students call “the flashy group”. However, where everyone thinks of him as bright, cheerful and always smiling, he is hiding a secret that only his high school classmate, Hayase Souta is aware of. Since their first year of high school, somehow Hayase has always ended up meeting Shina after a break up. So now Hayase sees Shina only as a big crybaby!

100754.description:
After leaving her otherworldly home to find her fellow dragon, Tohru, young Kanna found herself unofficially adopted by Tohru and her human companion, Miss Kobayashi. From attending elementary school to making new friends, Kanna learns to adjust to the human world with the curiosity and cuteness that only a young dragon could have!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Kanna's Daily Life
title.native: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン カンナの日常
title.romaji: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Kanna no Nichijou

100755.description:
Yo-Han is no stranger to unrequited love. As a child, he watched his older brother suffer that pain, and he knows the person with feelings always loses. So when he spots his senior, Mu-Gyeong, mooning after another boy, Yo-Han decides to step in. Confess or give up is his motto, that is, until Yo-Han’s the one with the crush on Mu-Gyeong.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

100756.description:
Some people live to work, others work to live. But Elma works to…eat! Elma is a Harmony Dragon who came to the human world to bring fellow dragon Tohru back home. In order to stay close to Tohru, Elma has taken a job as an office lady (OL). This charming new series from the world of Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid follows the 9-to-5 adventures of Elma as she learns to work and eat her way through the OL life. From mixed-up mixers to death marches, Elma learns that being an OL is just as hard as being a dragon…

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid: Elma’s Office Lady Diary
title.native: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン エルマのＯＬ日記
title.romaji: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Elma OL Nikki

100757.description:
Pyo Min is your average hetero dude in college: he likes his meat, never really has any money, and he really likes girls. Until he meets Jisoo, that is. After a night of too many drinks, he realizes that not only does he have it in him to sleep with the same sex, he...really likes it. But the deeper and deeper he finds his emotions for Jisoo become...the further Jisoo pulls away... What secret is Jisoo hiding?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Only One Who Didn't Know

100758.description:
Including nine of Junji Ito's best short stories, as selected by the author himself and presented with accompanying notes and commentary. It also includes one all new, previously unpublished story.

1. Used Record (from Ayatsuri no Yashiki)
2. Shiver (from Namekuji no Shoujo)
3. Fashion Model (from Souichi no Noroi Nikki)
4. Hanging Blimp (from Kao Dorobou)
5. Marionette Madness (from Ayatsuri no Yashiki)
6. Painter (from Tomie)
7. The Long Dream (from Tunnel no Tan)
8. Honored Ancestors (from Kao Dorobou)
9. Greased (from Voices in the Dark)
10. Fashion Model: Cursed Frame

All chapters except for 4 and 10 have been adapted by Ito Junji Collection.

(Source: VIZ Media)

CALAFRIOS: Seleção de Contos Favoritos de Junji Ito
Дрижаки. Збірка найкращих оповідань Джюнджі Іто

100759.description:
Due to renovations being done at his apartment, Saimiya Yuu asks his older brother’s best friend, Tasuku, if he can live with him until they are done. Tasuku has known Yuu for over six years and things between them are more complicated than anyone else realizes. How long will Yuu stay will Tasuku? And will anything come from this unusual situation?

Note: Includes the two-part one-shot Sensei ni Furesasete (I Want to Be Touched by Sensei).

100760.description:
A polite and lethargic boy was reincarnated in another world as a vampire bishoujo.

In this world of swords and magic, this protagonist who was reborn replete with all kinds of cheat powers was searching for one thing――!

“Three meals a day, snacks and an afternoon nap, I guess.”

Are you really the protagonist!

And thus begins the fantasy comedy of a vampire looking for the ideal moocher lifestyle…?
synonyms: A Transmigration Vampire Would Like to Take a Nap.
The Reincarnated Vampire Wants an Afternoon Nap

title.native: 転生吸血鬼さんはお昼寝がしたい
title.romaji: Tensei Kyuuketsuki-san wa Ohirune ga Shitai

100761.description: An alternative to the original Juuni Taisen light novel that plays out differently from the original. Now including western Astrology signs, which battle against the eastern Zodiac fighters.

100763.description: Minayoshi Yuu is trying to help his mother, Minayoshi Touko, who was once a national idol, recover from a strange "ailment." For her, he will do anything, even if it means finding a way to go back in time and erase the pain from her mother's past in order to bring her back to normal in the present.

100765.description:
Rei dreams of becoming a big-ticket film director, but when he stumbles into a chance meeting with a busty adult film star, his high school life takes a turn for the strange. Not only does his favorite porn star like him, she gains the power to grow to an enormous, towering size! Is alien technology to blame? Time travel? The end of the world? All manner of bizarre trouble lies ahead, and a gigantic, gorgeous woman is just the tip of the iceberg!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

100766.description:
Numerous prisoners were sent to mine a mysterious ore which lies underneath a certain island in the middle of an ocean, but after some time turns out there's something strange about the ore. The more you touch it the more it changes your skin and bones into a blue-ish color, and in the end, your entire body will turn into a strange ore.

The people who sent the prisoners, set up a research facility to do various experiments on them and treated them like test subjects.

The story starts when one of the researchers Kai, tries to help one of the patients escape.

100770.description: A shy, bashful, and nervous girl with inhuman strength named Torasawa Aiko tries to survive in a high school for delinquents (which she was forced into for being "accident prone"). The "abnormal" comedy begins.

title.native: 虎子、あんまり壊しちゃだめだよ
title.romaji: Torako, Anmari Kowashicha Dame da yo

100771.description:
A anthology series themed around idiosyncratic women.

Included one-shots: Tenchou to Baito no Hanashi, Risou no Hito

100772.description: Brow, a photographer, has a wonderful breath of fresh air come into his life.

100774.description:
As myriad seasons make their rounds, The scars of the past turn to memories. The spin-off serial of the painful and forlorn "distorted love story" has begun!

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

100775.description: Two highschool boys struggle to survive in the middle of a zombie apocalypse.

100776.description:
As a young boy, Jung-Hyuk felt drawn to the tough Tae-Su who often swooped in to save him from bullies. Now after years have passed, it’s his turn to make Tae-Su fall head over heels. Will plates of sweets be enough to win over his heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters
synonyms: สูตรลับฉบับเลิฟ

100777.description:
For the fourth year in a row, Jungsoo failed his college entrance exams. Shunned by family and friends as a failure in life, his one remaining joy is the pretty girl at cram school. But when a new hottie takes the seat next to him, Jungsoo can’t help but take notice —he’s fallen for a guy! Why can’t he stop gawking at this handsome boy? Will Jungsoo be able to concentrate and get into college this time?

(Source: TappyToon)

100778.description:
There's one man Yura despises at the day care his nephew attends: Mr. Kaji, the super cold and unfriendly day-care teacher. He's nice to the kids, but he doesn't even smile for the parents and guardians. To make things worse, Yura is traumatized from a past relationship, and Mr. Kaji sees right through him. But then, one day, this teacher Yura can't stand protects him when Yura's ex is being a complete jerk... by pretending to be his boyfriend...!!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Sensei wa Bucchoudura Shite Yatte Kuru
Sensei wa Bucchoudura Shite Yatte Kuru
Sensei wa Butchozura Shite Yatte Kuru

title.native: 先生は仏頂面してやってくる

100779.description:
Chapter 1-3: Tatsumi vowed to never start a relationship with a dad. But, after meeting his junior colleague, Yuto (a sweet single dad), the idea of the three of them spending time together seems like something he might want. Tatsumi decides to break it off before he gets too attached. One night, he tries to hit on Yuto to drive him away, but it unexpectedly works! Yuto isn't just some sweet dad who wants nothing for himself!

Chapter 4: Jun and Kazutaka have been dating for two years when Kazutaka asks Jun to live with him. The two work together and during one night of drinking, Kazutaka finds out that Jun becomes a kissing demon with any intake of alcohol!
synonyms: Kiss Akuma wa Hyakumankai Ai wo Chikau
Ookami Papa wa Hitsujizura shite Yatte kuru

title.english: Dirty Daddy Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
title.native: 狼パパは羊ヅラしてやってくる
title.romaji: Ookami Papa wa Hitsujizura shite Yattekuru

100783.description:
A collection of comedic 4-panel comics by various mangaka about the daily lives of the characters of Fire Emblem Heroes.

Fire Emblem Heroes: Eiyuu-tachi no Nichijou is published on the official Fire Emblem Heroes website, and published in print by Ichijinsha. The series has been published digitally in English as Fire Emblem Heroes: A Day in the Life since October 23, 2019.

Note: Includes 22 volume-exclusive chapters.
synonyms: Fire Emblem Heroes: Un Día con los Heroes
Fire Emblem Heroes: Life of Heroes

title.english: Fire Emblem Heroes: A Day in the Life
title.native: ファイアーエムブレム ヒーローズ 英雄たちの日常
title.romaji: Fire Emblem Heroes: Eiyuutachi no Nichijou

100786.description: One day, I woke up to find that my cat has become a human! A new day with catboy.
synonyms: Kitty Kitty Boy Of The Day

100787.description:
Minjae is smart, handsome, and thoughtful. He wakes up early to cook Hyukjoon breakfast and gets home early enough to make him dinner. He cleans around the apartment and makes sure to take care of his adoptive father. And like any dutiful son, he wants to follow in Hyukjoon's footsteps and become a teacher. He'd make any father proud. But Hyukjoon isn't proud of Minjae. Hyukjoon's son died years ago. And the one responsible for his death lives with him. Minjae isn't Hyukjoon's son. He's his target.

(Source: Lezhin)

100788.description:
Se Myeong is the brash young son of a mega corporate CEO. But the stubborn teaching assistant Yi Yeon refuses to break for him. Determined to win him over, Se Myeong will spare no expense —whether it’s wads of cash or a dose of crazy persistence! Is he just another guy that’s fallen for Yi Yeon’s pretty face?

(Source: Tappytoon)

100789.description:
Haruno saw Ichise for the first time in front of his high school, looking at the cherry blossoms in full bloom. He was crying. What a weird guy, Haruno thought...but he was the new classmate, and his seat was next to Haruno. The next thing Haruno knew about him was that he loved Japanese way of enjoying the four seasons. He was a returnee from United States. Ichise started the Four Seasons Club, with only one member. Haruno couldn't take his eyes off from Ichise...and he almost accidentally agreed to be a member of the club. But Haruno didn't know that the words he used were misunderstood by Ichise, and they'd become boyfriends.

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: A Warm Sunshine and The Four Seasons Club

title.english: Sunny Days With the Four Seasons Club

100793.description:
Friends since childhood, Haru and Hana do not have a typical relationship -- Hana is human, and Haru is her werewolf who must protect her. Although werewolves are starting to have more rights, they are still seen as exotic beasts by society. As the two fall in love, what will be their fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)

100794.description:
Hara meets a beautiful girl at a club one night, and goes home with her. After a sweet rendezvous, Go-Eun wakes the next morning to find Hara in her bed. Shocked, she kicks Hara out, because she has no recollection of sleeping with her. So who was Hara sleeping with? A story about Hara, Go-Eun and another ‘Go-Eun’!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

100795.description:
"Wanna be friends with benefits?" Two guys with the same last name were labeled by their classmates as the "cool one" and the "nerd." After discovering they share the same secret, the innocent Kazunari and experienced Hayato turn to each other for understanding and friendship. But, one day, Hayato asks Kazunari a startling question... Kazunari wants to prioritize friendship over desire, but Hayato's struggling with growing feelings of attraction he's been trying to hide... and one of them will have to give in...! This is a story about two high-school boys exploring their sexuality!!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: I'm Not Shouting Love To A Virgin!

title.english: How Can I Find Love When I've Still Got My V-Card!?
title.native: 童貞に愛なんて叫べない!

100796.description: Chronicling the adventures of the mangaka and his dog.
synonyms: ノンノン親分のかくれんぼ

100797.description: A oneshot that appeared in Monthly Spirits 2014-11 to celebrate Ito and Kazuo being in an interview together.

100798.description:
An anthology manga containing 8 short stories based around the theme "ZQN" (From "I Am a Hero")

1. Even If I Become a ZQN (Mizusawa Etsuko)
2. Ghost of a Smile (Yokoyari Mengo)
3. The Place Where the Zombies are (Ishiguro Masakazu)
4. Adolescence of the Dead (Ojiro Makoto)
5. She is a Slow Walker (Ito Junji)
6. Mister Ogre, Over Here (Torikai Akane)
7. I Am Not a Hero (Nogizaka Taro)
8. I Am a Hero Untold Creation Story (Yoshimoto Kouji)

title.native: アイアムアヒーロー 公式アンソロジーコミック 8 TALES OF THE ZQN
title.romaji: I Am a Hero Koushiki Comic Anthology: 8 TALES OF THE ZQN

100800.description:
Paralegal Aki Konishi returns to her apartment after work to find a tall, dark, and handsome man claiming her little sister is his bride...before leaping out the window with her in his arms! Aki pursues the kidnapper through a rift he opened in the fabric of reality in a desperate attempt to save her sister. Along the way, Aki encounters a dashing hero, a manly mage, and a handsome priest who unwittingly drags her into their battle against the Dark Lord, but what can a normal office worker do to help a hero and his team? Become the hero’s secretary, of course! Will Aki ever be able to save her sister from the Dark Lord? Find out in this exciting new fantasy light novel with a secretary twist!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: I Became the Secretary of a Hero!
title.native: 勇者様の秘書になりました

100801.description:
Nanoha and Chidori are best friends who attend the same all-girls high school—and also share a heart-pounding secret: they're lovers.

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: รักเราดั่งพายุดอกไม้

100802.description: One day, I was kidnapped. " What is it that you want?!" The kidnapper who hadn't responded strokes my face and finally speaks, "Something...you will probably hate."

100803.description:
The dreams of every high school boy: To have beautiful women fighting over him. The nightmare of every high school boy: Beautiful women trying to kill him? Yuya Kamigasaki is a normal female-form-loving high school boy, until the day that two beautiful princesses come to his world to tell him he’s the hero of theirs. The trouble? Those princess are on opposite sides, and one is doing everything in her power to keep the other from “reincarnating” him by force!

Yuya Kamigasaki is living the life any high-school boy would dream of: he’s got a house to himself, classes he can sleep through, and a childhood friend next door who grew into a total babe. But when an otherworldly princess with looks to die for shows up in his room and asks him to become the hero that will save her people, how can a guy refuse? That is, until he realizes she’s asked him to get reincarnated, and plans to send him through the great cycle of death and rebirth herself!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

100804.description: Chizuru Yuzuki, who swallowed Tsuruhime no Suzu when she was 6 years old, became the "key to Shikoku's return" to the fox clan who had been exiled from Shikoku, and was targeted as a bride!? It was the legendary army raccoon dog Kizaemon that saved Chizuru from the fox! A fox, raccoon dog, and crane three-way, bride-stealing battle with Shikoku folklore as a motif!

100805.description:
Sophomore Yu Yang is a real treasure. He has a cheerful, easy-going, and emphatic personality. Seniors look up to him, and he knows how to stand up for himself. Freshman Li Huan is moody and taciturn, haughty and, at times, outright rude. How will these two manage to get along, and where will it lead them..?

(Source: Aloha Comics)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

100807.description:
Despite being number one in the game “Tackfam”, Fumiya Tomozaki struggles in high school due to a lack of social skills. Fumiya was surprised to learn the identity of the number two “Tackfam” player after a fateful encounter—a popular, clever, and outgoing female classmate of his, Aoi Hinami. Aoi was taken aback to learn that the inept Fumiya was behind the username "nanashi," and she became determined to assist him in winning the "greatest game of all." With Aoi's help, Fumiya begins to progress in the wonderful "game of life" by overcoming the harsh challenges of social interaction and human relationships.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra.

100808.description: Living with strange creatures has its ups and downs.

title.native: 博士とスライムちゃん

100809.description:
Is being unable to see the red string of fate better?!

Since the encounter on the day of the high school entrance ceremony, dog-like boy, Makita Keita and cat-like girl, Ohara Tamaki have had the worst relationship. The story starts to progress when the both of them are put in the same class.

A little mysterious heart racing school youth graffiti begins!

100810.description: As a direct continuation of Mujaki no Rakuen, we see Shouta in even more troublesome and various situations.

title.native: 無邪気の楽園 パラレル

100816.description: Nii-san can’t do anything without me. That is what Shun has always believed. Waking him up every morning, helping him get ready for school, helping him study; Shun is perfectly content with looking after his helpless, airheaded older brother. But as Spring draws closer and graduation is just around the corner, how will this change their relationship?

title.native: カット・オフ・ホワイト

100818.description: Oka Kotarou, a regular 17 year old, is quite the player. But the number of times he has come while having sex is a big fat zero. Till one day, he decides to try anal masturbation. But suddenly, his childhood friend Murashige walks in while Kota is in the middle of his experiment. And what's more, Murashige offers to help...?!

title.native: 相互対立フラストレーション

100819.description:
Takatoshi Minamiyama majors in art at an university in Kyoto. On the train to the school, he sees Emi Fukuju and falls in love with her at first sight. Gathering up all his courage, he speaks to her. They begin to date and enjoy happy days together, but Emi reveals her secret to him.

Note: The manga adaptation of Nanatsuki Takafumi's novel of the same name.
synonyms: Tomorrow I Will Date With Yesterday's You

title.native: ぼくは明日、昨日のきみとデートする
title.romaji: Boku wa Ashita, Kinou no Kimi to Date suru

100820.description: When one childhood friend passed away, the two who were left behind reminisce the love from the past and the present.
synonyms: トライアングル (楓木まめ)
he said that you are cute

title.native: 彼がかわいいと言ったから

100823.description:
Taeyi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can’t help but hope, maybe, just maybe...it’s his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Seheon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Taeyi can’t control his anger. How dare Seheon play his brother’s song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? “If I ever catch you playing the piano again...that’ll be the end of you.” And with that begins their story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

(Source: Lezhin US)

100824.description:
To make a living, handsome Gangyoo hires himself out to lonely women in desperate need of a pretend boyfriend. But when his newest client is a prickly man named Soohyun, the job has never been so hard. Little does Gangyoo know that his own seedy past will catch up to bite him… and Soohyun harbors a dark secret of his own.

(Source: TappyToon)
synonyms: The House Where He Lives In

100825.description:
Vampire, zombie, or human; if it were you, which one would you choose?

It all started from making a selection in a social game. But what if the selection that you casually chose in the game became reality?

100826.description: His fiancee lost her parents so she will be living with the Hyeons, but Sang-Won is a middle school student and the fiancée is a 24 year old adult!? Sang-Won tries to deny that his fiancée is 9 years older than him, but seeing that she does not act her age, he then feels comfortable around her. His fiancée seems kind and innocent on the outside, but on the inside...

100827.description:
After cleaning the Calligraphy Club room one afternoon, Kiryuu Keiki found a love letter addressed to him on the club's desk. Eager at the possibility of finally getting a girlfriend, he opens the envelope only to find the words, "I like you" along with a pair of the sender's panties.

With only these panties as evidence, Keiki narrows down the identity to the four girls who helped him clean the club room that day: Tokihara Sayuki the lazy third-year president of Calligraphy Club, Koga Yuika a library committee member of foreign descent, Nanjou Mao, Keiki's slightly tsundere fellow classmate, and most awkwardly, Kiryuu Mizuha, Keiki's clean freak of a younger sister. Among at least three of these girls, Keiki believes is the one who left him the letter and their panties so with determination in his heart, he sets out to uncover which of these seemingly unorthodox ladies will become his girlfriend!

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.
synonyms: Would you even fall in love with a pervert as long as it's a cutie?
Kawaiikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Natte Kuremasu ka?

title.native: 可愛ければ変態でも好きになってくれますか？
title.romaji: Kawaikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Natte Kuremasu ka?
