100829.description:
Alice Academy is a famous school exclusive for children with an Alice, children with special powers. It's affiliate music school, the Alice Academy Opera Troupe, now opens up to regular students as well.

Andou Hikari's brother has an Alice and is a student of the Alice Academy. She decides to enroll to the school. There she is paired up with Shinomiya Ema, a student with a secret...

100830.description:
Idol Otaku, Aisaka Yousuke, wakes up one morning and realizes he's now a beautiful girl named Aisaka Yoko. Now with his new appearance and his great Idol knowledge, he will attempt to become the number one idol!

Note: The MangaBox serialization concluded on September 21, 2019 with 54 chapters. The series is currently ongoing as a doujin.
synonyms: Sets Sights On Becoming An Idol

title.native: キモオタ、アイドルやるってよ

100831.description: When she got into a pinch on the day of her high school entrance ceremony, Momose Minori transformed into a magical girl! Together with her classmate Shiori, she joins the magical girl club her seniors founded. But what use is being a magical girl when you don't have any enemies?!
synonyms: Magical Girls Would Never Ever Start the Fight At All

title.native: カラフル・マキアート！-魔法少女は戦わない。-
title.romaji: Colorful Macchiato!: Mahou Shoujo wa Tatakawanai.

100832.description:
Living in the mountains with his grandpa and his two little sisters, Lacile has always looked to the sky. He has dreams of seeing the fabled Flying City of the Heavens -- and one day his dream just might come true.

One day, he crosses paths with a strange girl named Leana who has the peculiar ability to float away unless she wears heavy steel boots that keep her on the ground. Like Lacile, Leana has dreams -- she wanted to see the outside world just once before she’s married off. But when machine soldiers pursue her, Lacile learns the truth: Leana is actually the princess of the Ariadne Empire, and her home floats in the sky...

100833.description:
15 years ago, a mysterious "Ray Ring" of light appeared, encircling the world, thereafter on occasion dropping mysterious objects called RUMs to the ground, which cause small localized disaster areas. The objects are predicted and the disasters contained, so the RUMs are largely ignored by the public.

Under this incredible backdrop, the ordinary Seita Tooki has just been confessed to by his lifelong enemy, Awayuki Kujou. Before he can give her a proper reply, a RUM unexpectedly descends, surveys the situation, and proceeds to kill him, as well as the entire city nearby as collateral damage. As it turns out, the Ray Ring above is apparently home to 7 billion "Grim Reapers", nearly all of whom seek to deny their newfound love.
synonyms: You, The One And Only, And The Seven Billion Grim Reapers
Tatta Hitori no Kimi to 70-oku no Shinigami

title.native: たった一人の君と七十億の死神
title.romaji: Tatta Hitori no Kimi to Nanajuuoku no Shinigami

100834.description: A short story of a bride-to-be's recollections of her family.
synonyms: The Day We Become Husband and Wife

100835.description:
Laura who had received special education to be a swordsman from her A-Rank adventurer father since a young age, enters the Royal Capital's Adventurer's school at the age of 9. Laura filled with expectation in her heart in hopes to make many swordsman friends. At the day of the entrance ceremony, Laura's sword aptitude value was measured at 107. Between normal students whose aptitude value is around 50-60, Laura was definitely a sword genius, but the magic aptitude that was measured after that was 9999! Laura was stunned, and while she didn't know what was even happening she was transferred to the Magic Department.

Contrary to Laura's will, she exerts her super-genius, and instantly becomes stronger than anyone in the school.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Kenshi o Mezashite Nyugaku Shitanoni Maho Tekisei 9999 Nandesukedo!?
I Applied as a Swordsman, But My Magic Aptitude is 9999?!
But My Magical Aptitude is 9999!? I Went to School to be a Swordswoman

100837.description:
On a certain morning a metabolic 35 year old salary man was suddenly transported to another world.

Without knowledge, without the ability to communicate, and I am especially not confident about my physical capabilities. I have no idea what to do.

However my current goal is to figure out how to keep living using the skills granted to me from the existence known as the interface.

Hero? Demon King? I know nothing about that. I am just a salaryman.

100839.description:
In the future after several decades from now. Virtual reality (VR) gaming has been finally realized. An old man who continued to wait for VR game, start gleefully the desire of a VR game.After finishing a fun tutorial, the old man who indulge in deep emotion looking back on life. He rest his body a little while lying in front of the main start. He ended up dozing out without noticed, he in an imperceptibly different place .

That how this volume has begun.

Though he gratefully accepted the cheat offered as an apology and reincarnated, he was reborn as a female elf! Then time passed, and Tomoaki now works as the intelligent and beautiful receptionist named Ilya in the Luneville branch of the Guild Association. In a world of swords and magic, her job in the guild begins today.

100843.description:
A god of a different world had abruptly appeared in Kamiya Yato's classroom and forcibly summoned the entire class to his world... except for him—because he was sleeping in a seat in the corner of the class, the round summoning magic circle didn't reach him—and he ended up staying here on Earth, but with brand-new skills.

After he made it through a whole year full of police interviews and journalism reports, he finally became a high school student, but the quiet days he had hoped for were far from over—be it terrorists who decide to occupy his school or even monsters from different world, one by one new incidents take place in the town he lives in...

Will a boy without any motivation be able to save the world?

100844.description:
A god of a different world had abruptly appeared in my classroom and semi-forcibly summoned the entire class to his world.----except for me, Kamiya Yato.

Because I was taking a seat in the corner of the class, the round summoning magic circle didn’t reach me and I ended up staying here on earth but with new skills. After I made it through a whole year full of police interviews and journalism reports, I finally graduated to my first year of high school.
synonyms: My Entire Class Was Summoned to Another World except for Me

title.native: クラスが異世界召喚された中俺だけ残ったんですが
title.romaji: Class ga Isekai Shoukan Sareta Naka Ore dake Nokotta n desu ga

100845.description: Two manga artists Naru and Maki share stories and daily life of their beloved dogs. You will forget about stress while being filled with love to these cute fluffy creatures.

title.native: マキナルの もふもふ犬まみれ！

100847.description:
With her flowing black dress, roaring chainsaw, and android, werewolf, vampire, and blood warrior at her service ... the Princess of Monsters is back! Yasunori Mitsunaga's masterpiece, Princess Resurrection, is hereby resurrected for a new series!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

100848.description:
The "erotic comedy" manga centers on Ayane Kurozumi, a beautiful detective who has legs that can take anything down. She takes various jobs so long as she gets proper monetary compensation.

(Source: Anime News Network)

100850.description:
Before Hajime was transported to Tortus, the Synergist Oscar Orcus was having his own adventure–but not willingly! Oscar is a simple working man, keeping his head down to earn his money and support an orphanage, until Miledi Reisen bursts into his life. She wants Oscar to join her in a quest to defeat the gods. Oscar refuses to chase after that kind of danger…until that kind of danger finds its way to him.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: From Common Job Class to the Strongest in the World Zero
อาชีพกระจอกแล้วทำไม ยังไงข้าก็เทพ ZERO

title.english: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest Zero
title.native: ありふれた職業で世界最強 零
title.romaji: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Zero

100851.description:
He knows her secret. She knows his secret too. He is the coolest guy in school. She is the curve wrecker of class. They make a deal in exchange to keep each other's secret. They should be strangers after that promise. But he offers to help her confess to her crush at the same time. Is that true? Is he just teasing her? Or...?

(Source: WebComics)

100854.description:
Giju is pretty for a boy; he’s different. That’s why he was called names growing up, why he was adopted by a rich artist couple, why his stepfather couldn’t keep his hands off of him. Broken and lost, all Giju wants is to lead a quiet life. The last thing he needs is to get involved with a gangster. But there’s more to Young-do the gangster than meets the eye; he’s different, too. Though he may have tattoos inked all over his body, an imposing build, and a foul mouth, he’s a romantic at heart—he only joined a gang because of his first love. Set in Saha, a conservative seaside town in southern Korea, this is a poetic tale of two souls in search of their place in the world.

(Source: Lezhin US)

100856.description:
Teams of fighters from around the world have gathered to answer one burning question: Who's the strongest warrior alive? Every single character from the legendary The King of Fighters video game series is on wild display in this brand new, high-octane fighting manga!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: THE KING OF FIGHTERS: A NEW BEGINNING
title.native: THE KING OF FIGHTERS ～A NEW BEGINNING～
title.romaji: THE KING OF FIGHTERS: A NEW BEGINNING

100858.description:
The fact that Kohiruimaki Karen is 183 centimeters tall has always been something she's felt extremely self-conscious about as an introverted high school girl. But in the world of games, she can be whoever she wants to be! In the popular Gun Gale Online game, she's Ren, a short, all pink, P90 wielding bombshell who's aiming to win the next battle royale!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Sword Art Online Alternative Gun Gale Online
title.native: ソードアート・オンライン オルタナティブ ガンゲイル・オンライン
title.romaji: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

100859.description:
Sarang loves Jinwoo, Jinwoo loves Woojung, and Woojung loves… you get the idea. But after a mix-up of affections and tangled signals, can they find a happy ending stuck between love and friendship, or will even family bonds be lost in heartache?

(Source: Tappytoon)

100860.description:
With a dark past behind him, Jawoon sets out to become a new person by being ordained as a priest. However, with his only disciple, Miseol, gone missing, he has no choice but to take out his once sealed sword and revisit his past. Accompanied by 7 other outlaws with similar agendas in mind, he embarks on his rescue mission.

(Source: Lezhin)

100861.description: The story centers on Norm, the god of normal people, and his daily encounters with the other gods in his pantheon.
synonyms: Kamigami Every Day ~Bonjin to Yukai na Nakamatachi~

100862.description:
Sena's built the perfect life for herself. She a has a caring boyfriend, a job she actually enjoys, and all the comforts she could hope for. But behind her happy facade, she hides a past marred by a past relationship with another woman.
Jinri isn't thrilled to be working at an office, much less to be running a department her father set up for her. She's spent years living a carefree live and adding to a long list of casual relationships with men and women.
When these two meet, they'll have to re-evaluate their lives as well as the men and women they share it with.

(Source: Lezhin US)

100863.description:
Collected high school girl doujinshi by Yuri manga artist Momomono Moto.

(Source: Yuricon)

100865.description:
Kiyonaga Akane, a new delinquent who’s weak at fighting but has a strong will. One day, he got beaten up by Yankees from another school, then, his hero - Kidou Ryouji and Kurokawa Tarou saved him. They became closer and Kurokawa keep teasing Akane every day. Not only that, Kurokawa also do perverted things with Akane?!

(Source: YaoiSM 801)

Includes: Renai Bug no Mitsukekata (恋愛バグの見つけ方) and a side story.
synonyms: The worst Yankee and loser dog me

title.native: 最凶ヤンキーと負け犬な俺
title.romaji: Saikyo Yankee to Makeinu na Ore

100866.description: Takase Ai is a horny, enthusiastic university student who looks aggressive but who is actually an idiot. Cute girls from university invite him to a goukon and he happily accepts thinking “Alright, time to get some chicks!” But oh no, the girls cancel at the last minute. The four jobless guys who met each other at the goukon end up drinking together. After Ai complains that he wants to go home, the others’ reply is “Then how about we do it together?” and suddenly an orgy party begins!?

title.native: ヤリすぎパーリィナイ

100867.description:
Hanaura, a self-proclaimed jerk, is a bonified loner in his class. Suddenly, Tsuzuki, the most popular guy in school, confesses his feelings for him and kisses him...? For as much as he tries, Hanaura can't refuse Tsuzuki's advances, and when they're together, Hanaura begins to worry whether he can actually be of use to Tsuzuki, the perfect... This is a coming-of-age love story between two opposites: a high-spec elite and a cynical loner!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: What’s wrong with having a shit personality?

title.english: What's Wrong with Being a Jerk?
title.native: 性格クズでなにが悪い
title.romaji: Seikaku Kuzu de Nani ga Warui

100868.description:
It's a showdown for the ages as the legendary hero takes on the corpse god necromancer, but when the dust settles, something isn't quite right... In the final moments of their epic confrontation, the corpse god's final gambit shot was wholly unexpected — reincarnation magic! Across space and time, a boy named Polka Shinoyama awakens feeling...not quite himself...... Who could've expected that the climactic battle between good and evil would turn out like this??

(Source: MangaUP!)

Note: Twentieth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title.native: デッドマウント・デスプレイ

100869.description:
You thought it was over? Surprise! Umaru and friends are back for one final hurrah, with laziness levels powered up, and unexpected new sides of all your favorite characters. But no matter how much changes, one thing will always be the same: the himouto life is full of love and laughs!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

100870.description:
Mitsuru is working in the sex industry at a 'Hole Wall Speciality Shop' to help pay his family's debt, but was accidentally discovered by an old classmate Keita.
Keita swears to help out his friend with the money problems, but when all is said and done, will he still be able to see Mitsuru only as a friend...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

100872.description:
The stories of the everyday life of a black mage and a slime that run a magic store together as master and servant.

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, 12 omake and 5 extra chapters.

100874.description:
While her friends are interested in cute cafés and getting boyfriends, Yanagi Riku finds it hard to talk about what she actually likes. They also think that her interest in the hot but unsociable Fushimi-kun is in bad taste, but she actually has a crush on him. One day, instead of accompanying her friends to the popular new café they found, she secretly seeks out an old café in order to indulge in her own interests: old-fashioned things!

When the person at the counter turns around, she finds out that it is Fushimi-kun! He actually invites her to talk and they find out that they have similar tastes, and promise to talk again, but the next day he's unsociable as ever.

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters from the volume releases.

100875.description:
Tsurusaki Naru and his childhood friend/roommate Miyazawa Kei are inseparable. Kei gives into every single one of Naru whims, and Naru is only more than happy with this kind of friendship.
Until one day, Kei is confessed to by another classmate and agrees to date them.

title.native: 悪魔ちゃんはももいろ

100877.description: Suguru and Yoshiichi were neighbors who were always together until the day Suguru decides to move away. When they entered junior high, as promised, Suguru came back. But he was unable to transition into their high school, so he is thinking of taking exams for other schools. Yoshiichi’s image of the Suguru who’s always by his side shatters a bit. He became upset, lonely and jealous. Even when his heart swells so much and all he can think of is him…On top of Amadare no Koro, we’ve included an epilogue of their story, titled “Engage Key Holder” and a side story of Suguru’s friend’s love story titled “Haru no Iki”.

100879.description:
About a dog exposing himself.

(Source: MagnaUpdates)

100880.description:
Haruki is a poor omega, who is the oldest of seven kids. Even though he has multiple part-time jobs and sacrifices eating well in order to pay for his meds, he still remains the top of his 3rd year class. Life may not be ideal, but Haruki had accepted it and is used to the hardships. But all of a sudden, he is being stalked by a very stubborn 1st year alpha…

Includes a side story.
Includes one shot: Ori no Naka ni Koneko to Ookami (檻の中に子猫と狼)

title.native: 僕らがつがいになるまで
title.romaji: Bokura ga Tsugai ni Naru made

100881.description:
A Bright and Cheerful guy, Yuto.
A Quite and Gay guy, Ryou.
A Handsome and Bad guy, Kei.

During their high school days, the three of them were always together, but Kei liked Ryou and Ryou like Yuto. Six months later after their graduation Yuto was reunited with the other two by chance in a certain bar. But he felt something had changed from their high school times because of the subtle air between Kei and Ryou...!
synonyms: Bokura no Koi o Kimi wa Shiranai
You Don't Know Our Love Affair

title.native: ぼくらの恋をきみは知らない
title.romaji: Bokura no Koi wo Kimi wa Shiranai

100882.description: Yukishiro works in the business department of a big company and has recently become “executive manager” at such a young age. He has great expectations from the people around him and he’s very popular too, but he has a secret. The only one who knows about that is Saotome, his subordinate, who is Yukishiro’s kouhai since high school. Saotome has always known this secret and kept protecting Yukishiro. Although he’s very clever, he works only for Yukishiro’s sake. Worrying about Saotome, Yukishiro decided to open up only to him, but one rainy day, he meets the vice-president Hiiragi by chance, and the gears of destiny start to go crazy for him…
synonyms: Elite Ω is Drowning in the Night
Elite Omega is Drowning in the Night
Elite Omega wa Yoru ni Oborete
Erito Ω Wa Yoru ni Oborete
Erito Omega wa Yoru ni Oborete

title.native: エリートΩは夜に溺れて
title.romaji: Elite Ω wa Yoru ni Oborete

100883.description:
My friend of 15 years Hyung-Woo has always been secretive about things. But one hazy night, he's bitten my lips because... he was a vampire all along! "I'm a vampire and now... so are you!" Why do I suddenly feel... thirsty?

(Source: Tappytoon)

100884.description:
『I’m terribly sorry』

A god was suddenly prostrating in front of Kayano Takumi. He was apparently killed by mistake. Moreover, he can’t be reborn again. However, he is able to live in a different world? Then, let’s do that, please. The god made a mistake again and transferred me into a dangerous forest. Seriously, what’s going on? Besides, there are children here. I can’t leave them here, I will take care of them.

(Source: Shinsori Translations)
synonyms: Isekai Yururi Kikou ~Raising Children While Being an Adventurer~

title.english: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring
title.native: 異世界ゆるり紀行 ～子育てしながら冒険者します～
title.romaji: Isekai Yururi Kikou: Kosodate Shinagara Boukensha Shimasu

100885.description:
Every night at 10, Dong-Gyun locks himself up in his room, grabs a box of tissues, and watches a live cam boy show hosted by Alex, a BJ (broadcast jockey). Timid Dong-Gyun admires not only Alex’s ripped body, but his candor in sharing his sexual experiences with viewers. One night, Dong-Gyun downs too many drinks at a school networking event and passes out. When he wakes up, he’s in bed staring up at a shirtless hunk. A hunk who looks an awful lot like... Alex.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

100886.description: Japan has been ruined for several years, and several "things" roam the cities. The world has ended and the meal begins, and Ryoko's stomach is empty. A menu battle action series begins.

100887.description: Chiaki Asami was transferred to Shuurin High School into the Suzuka Dorm, and there Nachi Kirishima who had a beautiful face like a model is to be his roommate. When he’s just getting accustomed to dormitory life, a welcome party for Chiaki suggested by Nachi is carried out. One night, Chiaki encounters lewd play between Nachi, Shinobu, and Haru…
synonyms: You are a Nasty Night Queen

title.native: 女王様のルームメイト

100888.description: Childhood friends Tsutsuji and Kouji live in a tiny village. Due to the lack of students, their school's scheduled to be closed at the end of the year; they'll be its final batch. The two of them have always been together, but at this rate they may be separated after graduation...

title.native: ハイ・ファイ・ランデブー

100889.description: Office worker Nishina has a crush on his sempai who turns out to write BL novels & observes him for "puppy seme" reference. Using this once in a lifetime luck, Nishi suggests they date to help sempai. Until a drunk evening makes the studying more... concrete.

title.native: へたれワンコと腐男子先輩

100890.description:
Ch.1-3 : Futari Bocchi no Shokutaku
One day, Natsuo a part-timer picked up a young man, Keisuke in front of his house. He began to look after the man since becoming attracted to him eating so deliciously. They have sex as thanks for the meal. They don't even know each other's names.
It was a strange relationship -. But Keisuke suddenly proposes "Let's learn about each other one step at a time each day!?"

Ch.4-5 : Sayonara Hero

Extra

100892.description: A rootless mercenary meets the Crown Prince of a certain country. This meeting just might be a ray of light in the darkness for the supernatural war that will soon begin to tear the land apart.

100894.description:
Infamous gag manga author Man☆Gatarou's adaptation of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's The Little Prince.

Includes 9 bonus chapters.

100895.description: Adults who work like a machine, forgetting things that were important. A girl who felt stuffiness in this city that was deprived of her memory · Mia .... Here, boys and girls were kidnapped, and there were cases in which they were safely protected afterwards. At one point, Mia met a young man named Jouma and saw the illusion of a fairy or expressive child in his house. Is the illusion caused by the machine created by Joaa? A terrible "crow" that red eyes on Mia who came in contact with Jouma is approaching ...!

title.native: MIA 雲上のネバーランド

100897.description:
A town and grass wall that is about two hours from the city center. It was believed that there was a god protecting the land called “Chitose” on this land. Hachimori Hina, a high school girl who came to grant his wishes to the land god Chitose who has been withdrawn because of human distrust. While the festival “God Festival” is held once in 12 years, the two learn about each other...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

100898.description: Having met during the cherry blossom season, the shy Sakura's reactions which are always fresh and funny captured Umeya's interest. Because of that, he ends up always teasing him. One day, in a drunken moment, Umeya forced a kiss on Sakura. If all he meant to do was just to tease Sakura, then he wondered why does his heart pounds for him...

100899.description: Hibi starts working at his old school as a librarian and reunites with his former senpai, Sugino, who's now a teacher there. Although he confessed to Sugino in high school, he was told that his feelings were a misunderstanding and that he didn't understand the feeling of 'like'. Even so, Sugino now says that he likes Hibi. The feelings Hibi has for Sugino now is no longer love- it is hatred...
synonyms: หากรักนั้นถักทอได้ดั่งใจ

100901.description:
Kohinata Asunaro is your regular everyday high school student. He likes light novels, porn games, and fantasizing about the girls in his class. One day when walking home from school he inexplicably releases a demon from a sealed bottle. Her name is Zepafur, and she won't rest until her debt is repaid!

"Now begins the Lovey Dovey Harem Royale!" cries the demon, weaving a most curious magic. As a result, Asunaro's regular high school life transforms into a love-comedy series of harem shenanigans, with four girls from his school all vying for his affection, wow!

But... Unbeknownst to our dopey protagonist, the four girls are in the midst of a horrific survival game under threat of death and eternal torture. She who fails to capture Asunaro's heart will be confined to the depths of Hell and killed ad infinitum! Just who will survive? Who will thrive? And who will meet their demise?

(Source: Sol Press)

Note: Includes chapter 0.
synonyms: The Love Harem Game's End When the Notice Comes

title.english: Harem Royale: When the Game Ends
title.native: 恋愛ハーレムゲーム終了のお知らせがくる頃に
title.romaji: Renai Harem Game Shuuryou no Oshirase ga Kuru Koro ni

100902.description:
In a world where demon lords build dungeons and devour human emotions, one rookie demon lord, Procel, has a new idea. Procel seeks to build a revolutionary new dungeon where humans and monsters can coexist. But first, Procel must defeat the Wind Demon Lord. Based on the light novel series in Japan, this sexy fantasy tale has built something truly special!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Demon Lord’s building a city! ~The strongest Dungeon is a modern day city~
สร้างเมืองกันเถอะค่ะ! คุณพ่อจอมมาร!

title.native: 魔王様の街づくり！～最強のダンジョンは近代都市～
title.romaji: Maou-sama no Machizukuri!: Saikyou no Danjon wa Kindai Toshi

100903.description: Two friends who look at each other differently, a straight one and a gay one, they’re still together since Highschool. Is there more to their feelings?
synonyms: Someday Love and End of the Summer

title.native: いつかの恋と夏の果て
title.romaji: Itsuka no Koi to Natsu no Hate

100904.description:
Katou is a virgin weeb who is also highly obsessed with romance visual novel games. As he strides his way towards full completion, he finds himself facing a totally new character – who happens to be a man! While Katou struggles to achieve his full completion challenge, a service ticket arrives on his doorstep one fine day. Confused, he follows the instruction on the ticket, heading towards the meeting point, just to find out that the person who is supposed to meet him looks exactly the same as the pretty male character he’s been trying to challenge in his game…?

(Source: Yaoi Sekai)

100905.description:
Metropolitan police investigator, Tsutsumi, is an eccentric who loves solving cases above all others. Imprudent with a wicked tongue, he only needs to find a thin thread of clue to solve cases with his sharp intuition and insight.

Meanwhile, Tsutumi’s partner, Sakuma, is a newbie who got assigned to the Metropolitan Police department 6 months ago. But a certain incident caused Sakuma to change. Struck by curiosity, Tsutsumi embraced him when Sakuma changed from his usual demeanor and goes into heat…

100906.description:
Ichigaya and Tomoki are high school students, they don't really know each other. One day Tomoki falls asleep during class and wakes up to find that the "cool" Ichigaya has painted his nails with classmate's polish. The only way to get it off it to go to the home of Ichigaya. There Tomoki steps into the lonely life of Ichigaya.

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)

title.native: 器用な指先、不器用な爪先
title.romaji: Kiyou na Yubisaki, Bukiyou na Tsumasaki

100907.description:
Third year of middle school, fifteen years old. At this age, the mind id full of lewd things. To my surprise, most of the lewdness was done with my best friend.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 41 and 43.
synonyms: 君がかわいい理由 Second

100908.description:
Being called "Sensei" all the time and having to act worthy of it was too heavy a burden to bear, so I fled to my home town. But amidst the nostalgic scenery, a mysterious man appeared before me...

Rin, the water dragon god to whom Chiharu has been betrothed, can be disarmingly friendly and charming, but inside lurks an animalistic ferocity. Knowing that he can’t escape Rin’s protective embrace, can Chiharu make himself fall in love with the god instead?

(Source: SuBLime Manga)
synonyms: เกล็ดแห่งเทพเจ้า

100909.description:
Seto works for a large corporation and has relocated to a desert kingdom to be in charge of infrastructure development. There, he meets the driving force of the project, Crown Prince Zia, a beautiful, good-humored and diligent member of the royal family. Goodwill develops between them as Seto works together with Zia, until one day, Zia suddenly goes, "Would you like to fuck me?" and turns up for a late-night romp...?! Bearing the responsibility of a country and a love that crosses social boundaries. Tarnished by gunpowder smoke and blood, a fairytale of a desert kingdom.

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)

100913.description:
Meet Meme, the good-for-nothing daughter of the Demon World's mighty Summoners Clan leader. Her dad has kicked her out into the human realm to learn some responsibility, and she needs to find a home! Enter Sentarou Narigane, wealthy landlord of Kuroyuri Apartments. Suffering from the worst case of malaise, Sentarou offers Meme a free apartment on one condition: She has to be his entertainment!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Strange Creature at Kuroyuri Apartments
title.native: 黒ゆり荘の変なゐきもの。

100915.description:
Four short stories. Four introverted and slightly awkward men. And the four girls they are trying to understand.

(Source: Haikaka)

100917.description:
After experiencing a traumatic incident involving a previous lover, Jiho is too afraid to tell his classmate Soohan that he likes him. Thankfully, Soohan can hear other people’s thoughts and asks him out first. But, as we all know, love isn’t always that easy. Will Jiho and Soohan really get their happily ever after?

(Source: Lezhin)

100918.description:
Taeho’s barely scraping by after moving out of his parent’s home when he catches just the lucky break he needs: an easy, overpaid job as the manager of top celebrity, Wooyeon (overpaid being the key word here). The job starts to take a weird turn when Taeho notices that people tend to like Wooyeon a little too much... Fans are one thing, but the adoration Wooyeon ignites is something else. And why is everyone at Wooyeon’s agency related to him? Meanwhile, Wooyeon can’t figure out Taeho doesn’t adore him like everyone else. How long will it be before Taeho discover’s Wooyeon’s secret...?

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: Can't Take My Eyes Off You!

100919.description:
Minjae Kim was the kind of guy who caught your eye. That’s where all the trouble began for Taehwa Lee. The two met in high school, hit it off and then some. All the rumors said that they were together. Intimate. Abuse, betrayal, lies and love, if that was the only truth, they wouldn’t be in this mess.

(Source: Tapas)

Note includes nine extra chapters.

100920.description:
"Just stay alive, young master."

Sora has descended from the mountains to guard the sickly Jungha. The two have a set of rules to guide them: One, Sora decides what is considered an emergency. Two, Jungha must listen to Sora in an emergency. Three, Jungha must not bully Sora. Will they be able to stick to them?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes a prologue and 3 side stories

100924.description: Jae Jun has regularly have broken up with girlfriends. Understand him, his friends decide to meet at a place called "Pea-Ch". Jae Jun arrives at the bar to realize that the place he is at is a gay bar and that it is not the place his friends had in mind. Coincidentally, he meets senior from high school, Yoon Jae Kang, who he liked 10 years ago.

100926.description:
Sung Moon High is fields one the country's top 5 high school baseball teams. On the field, players hit hard, run fast, and pull their weight to strive towards victory. Off the field, competition is fierce with students vying for position - and affection. Some might play for love of the game, others are just in it for love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

100927.description:
"Allow me to confess. I love taking videos in secret." Natsumi, a fudanshi high schooler, spends his days filming all kinds of boy's love events at his school, sharing these videos with his subscribers online. One day, he receives a request to film Mizuha and Ukyo, a pairing so raw and real that even Natsumi felt compelled to keep his distance until now... And so, it's time for our little fudanshi to get dragged into a real BL story!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

synonyms: it’s a fist. If it’s open

title.native: 握ればこぶし ひらけば掌

100929.description:
The story is set in the Stone Age. An unconscious woman is discovered by a family of foragers. In need of a bride, the eldest "son" (actually a daughter) decides to marry her.

Hunting mammoths, singing, dancing, taking a nap, occasionally going to hot springs. This is the daily life of Stone Age girls who are living comfortably in the period before the Ice Age.

100930.description:
The plot centers on the titular Tsubaki Kunoichi, the best student in her school, and a curiosity that she cannot reveal.

Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.
synonyms: In the Heart of Kunoichi Tsubaki

title.native: くノ一ツバキの胸の内
title.romaji: Kunoichi Tsubaki no Mune no Uchi

100932.description:
Hui-Su’s world revolves around Chan-Young, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn’t mind cheering Chan-Yeong from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems. He doesn’t care if people only know him as “Chan-Yeong’s friend.” Then one day, Hui-Su starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there’s a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Hui-Su in Class 2 and he’ll tell you what to do!) and with that, Hui-Su suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn’t even know what to do about his own crush!

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Note: Includes one prologue and ten side story chapters.
synonyms: ลีฮีซู ห้อง 2

100933.description:
Da-Jeong has lived with Dr. Lee Seh-Yeon for as long as he can remember, but his memories are muddled and don't go back very far. All he knows for certain is that the doctor must give him an injection every day, his diet can only consist of raw meat, and he is forbidden from venturing outdoors. He is, in fact, the last surviving zombie from an outbreak that humanity managed to contain a decade ago, and was the product of an experiment that Dr. Lee managed to rescue him from before he could be disposed of. The doctor knows that he can't keep Da-Jeong hidden forever, just as he knows that Da-Jeong's questions about why he is "sick" will one day need to be answered. He slowly begins introducing Da-Jeong to the outside world, but things become more complicated when his undead patient begins to fall in love with him.

Notes:
Chapter count includes a prologue.
Winner of the third MrBlue Comic Contest.

100934.description:
Cute, straightforward, and sparkling stories!
This is a collection of one-shots by a very talented rookie, Andou-sensei!

The title story is about a little girl who played "janken" (rock-paper-scissors) on the stairs with her childhood friend.
Their love deepened and the relationship changed over the years as they went up and down the stairs....
The changing relationship is very realistic and adorable!
The other four stories in the collection are cute and touching love stories as well!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

100936.description:
Lloyd is a novice adventurer who's dream is to discover "true strength" in the capital he's always admired, despite growing up with neighbors who always considered him weak. The story starts with him departing from his hometown, which just so happens to be located right next to...one of the most dangerous dungeons in the world?! Lloyd may think of himself as powerless, but when he goes to the city that serves as the starter town for adventurers, the difference between him and everyone else couldn't be starker!

(Source: Yen Press)

100937.description:
In a devastated post-apocalyptic future, Earth is a ruinous wasteland. Humanity’s only remaining strongholds are mobile fortress cities called Plantations. Massive beasts known as klaxosaurs, the planet’s new apex predators, have pushed mankind to the edge of extinction, and within the walls of the Plantations, things are no less dire. Humans no longer love or reproduce–adults live on in sterile immortality while children are regarded as nothing more than parasites, artificially created to pair up and pilot the Plantations’ giant defense robots known as Franxx. Former child whiz kid Hiro fails out of the piloting program after falling out of sync with his co-pilot, and a fateful decision to skip his group’s graduation ceremony puts him on a collision course with a horned girl known as Zero Two, whose co-pilots always end up dead. She claims Hiro as her “darling,” but what can that word even mean in such a loveless world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: ダーリン・イン・ザ・フランキス

100938.description:
Byrd who can make anyone love him for 7 days. And Jude, who needs the magic of Byrd in order to become the national team judo player. Magic… ? Or really fall in love? What's the end of this upbeat deal?

(Source: BomToon, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: ぼくは童貞魔法つかいのいいなり

100941.description: Final season of Cheese in the Trap.

100942.description:
Third season of Cheese in the Trap.

100943.description: Second season of Cheese in the Trap.

100944.description:
Oda Ayumi is in love with her childhood friend, Ootani Ichita, who is actually also in love with her but is too shy to take the next step.
Ootani was practicing practicing his confession when he was overheard by classmate Takatsuki. Now Takatsuki is helping Ootani... even for a good friend isn't he too dedicated?

100945.description:
After his father collapsed and is hospitalized, Yukinori takes over his welding factory in Kyushu as the acting president. But Yukinori, who is unfamiliar with the company and has no idea what is going on, is told by his father to rely on Maki, the factory manager. Maki is loved by everyone in the company because he's dedicated and cherishes his work, even though he's brooding, unfriendly and rough. However, one day Maki finds out that Yukinori is gay and says, "You absolutely want to get fucked while you try to run away" while pushing him down?!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

100946.description:
Yuki Hayakawa has cherished Takao Mochizuki since they were kids, but now Takao has found someone more special... Yuki comes out of this love triangle feeling defeated. Takao's homeroom teacher, Mr. Kanda, offers to comfort Yuki and suddenly kisses him, whispering, "I've been watching you all this time." Feeling sad and lost, Yuki lets Mr. Kanda make love to him... Where will this relationship that started with a physical connection go? This is Nako's debut manga about a mature teacher and a broken-hearted, hot-and-cold high school boy! Includes a bonus page and an extra bonus page exclusive to Renta!.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Kono Hoshi de Ichiban Akarui Tokoro - Yuki no Baai

title.english: The Brightest Place on This Planet
title.native: この星でいちばん明るいところ
title.romaji: Kono Hoshi de Ichiban Akarui Tokoro

100947.description:
“I’ve already loosened my ass up…”
College student Ise Natsume may look like an ikemen, but he’s just a silent person with a lifeless face. Even though he has only a few friends, let alone lovers, he falls in love with someone he just met. That person is Amano Haru, a classmate who’s cute, friendly, and expressive, the exact opposite of Natsume.

As he watches Haru from a distance like a stalker, his friend decides gives him a warning: “That guy has no morals. He’s a pleasure seeker who will do anything. In other words, he’s a bitch!”

“There’s no way someone as cute as him would do that…” is what Natsume believed at first until Haru intrudes into his home and tells him, “They found out that I was three-timing them, so let me stay over~!” After Natsume reflexively pins him down and they have sex, they end up becoming sex friends. Natsume doesn’t want just the pleasure, he wants to date Haru, but Haru doesn’t agree……

A pure love story about how a slow to mature ikemen and a cute playboy go from being sex friends to lovers.

title.english: I Fell in Love with Him at First Sight

Fairy Tail x Rave
While on a mission to find and defeat a troublesome mage, Natsu, Lucy, and Happy are split up in an unfamiliar town. At the same time, Haru and Elie are also separated. In a fortunate turn of events, Elie runs into Lucy and Happy, who are looking for Natsu. Meanwhile, Haru stumbles upon Natsu, who is struggling with motion sickness. Although she seems friendly, Elie matches the description of the troublesome mage that the Fairy Tail members were assigned to locate. To make matters worse, Natsu learns of Haru's relationship with her and suspects them to be accomplices.

In this crossover between two popular series, Fairy Tail x Rave follows the two groups as they discover their similarities with each other. As the miscommunications add up, they are pitted against one another in a heated clash of powers.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

100950.description:
Shiina and Kazuya become brothers when their parents decide to marry. With a 5 year difference, Kazuya who works as a chef takes care of his new younger brother who cannot eat strangers' food, apart from Shiina's. 3 years later, Kazuya seems to have grown more unsociable with bouts of jealousy over his brother to the point of sexually assaulting him. Shiina is lost as he does not understand what has changed and what he can do to fix things, while running away is not working out.

Can the 2 brothers finally communicate their feelings and bridge the gap?

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

100951.description:
A collection of oneshots.

Chapters 1-3 + extra: Koi to Kedama to Otonari-san
Ichinose, who is not very good at socializing, meets his next door neighbor, Tsuchiya, and his pet cat. After becoming good friends, Ichinose is extremely grateful to Tsuchiya. However, Tsuchiya, full of feelings for the other, desperately tries to hide his desire...!?

100952.description:
High school senior Tomouchi Takumi has terrible grades and no life goals, but prides himself on being decent at video games. After experiencing a terrible losing streak in the popular robot fighting game C.O.D.A.S., Takumi is confronted by the beautiful and intelligent Class Rep Minahara Satsuki, who has a particular set of skills...

(Written by Edo)

100953.description: A group of young people tormented by ghosts join hands to find a scientific explanation for their paranormal experiences -- and a way out of them. In their desperate quest, they visit a haunted house and encounter a terrifying, blood-thirsty ghost with a tragic past. Will they come out alive? Or will they too become possessed by demon spirits?

100954.description:
After an unexpected family tragedy, a reclusive high school student is forced to leave his home -- only to face something much scarier: a reality where monsters are trying to wipe out humanity. Now he must fight alongside a handful of reluctant heroes to try and save the world before it’s too late.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

100959.description:
Even in high school, Ritsu and Uta really get along, but suddenly, they have to pretend to be lovers...!?

The real brother-sister exciting love comedy starts!!

100960.description: A virgin elf beauty is offered as a sacrifice to a legendary monster to save the village and the monster eats her BUT she was spit out the second after because she tastes disgusting and had super stinky feets among other things, so the monster spoke... CHANGE!... The pretty elf somehow got to live only to be sent back to the monster again after the villagers tried to "fix her to taste better", now more healthy than ever went back to the monster.... but it didnt work out, she was spat again and again, now the elf beauty is pissed.

100961.description: A seemly perfect man, Y-rul, decides to become a priest to repent and escape his broken past where he lost his true love, Shio. But fate is cruel and Y-rul and Shio meet again two weeks before her wedding to another man. Their passion and love for each other is evident but the restraints that exist in their current lives as well as the pain of the past, may be too much for them to overcome.

100962.description: Fujimino Daisuke was often pushed around by his tomboy childhood friend Hino Matsuri but several years later, they meet each other again in college where Daisuke discovers that Matsuri has developed into quite a lovely young woman. But despite that, much to Daisuke's dismay, she has also retained most of the tomboy personality that made her a little difficult to get along with in the past.

100963.description:
A "priest expelling demons action" story that centers on a priest (bōzu) who lives alone on a strange mountain, when he meets a young man who was raised by wolves.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes a special one-shot.

100964.description:
One thousand Japanese high school students are suddenly thrust into an unfamiliar world rife with dangerous monsters. Their survival becomes dependent on those who awaken to unexplainable powers. Majima Takahiro, a normal second-year student, does not get any such power. Instead, he joins the majority of students building the homestead. But when a group of empowered students revolt, Takahiro is left wandering the forest on the verge of death. Having lost all faith in humanity, he finds salvation from an unlikely source: monsters!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: モンスターのご主人様

100967.description:
Romance? That can't possibly happen to us!
New comic romance concept.

100969.description:
As a zombie with memory loss, school life is still a must! While fighting with his instinctive hunger for humans, he also falls in love with his destined one. But it seems like not only does his lover know how he became a zombie, but he was also a schemer behind the scenes. In this SM danmei, the truth of the zombie gradually emerges.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes a prologue.

100970.description:
The story follows the lives of three women. Kana is 31 years old: divorced, she grows by herself the four-year-old daughter, Kaede. Yuuri is an austere office employee, which makes her look much older than her actual age of 28 – but who has a dissolute past. At last, Nao, a 36-year-old fashion designer who is very popular with men. The three, not having other friends, decide to share the house.

(Source: Animeclick)

Includes 1 bonus chapter.

title.native: 地獄のガールフレンド

100971.description:
The story centers on 29-year-old Yuuka, who was just dumped by her boyfriend, and her 25-year-old younger sister Sumika. The two return to their mother's hometown of Osaka since their mother has a serious illness. Her mother suddenly gives Yuuka a "mother's order": Yuuka must move with her and Sumika to live together in Tokyo.

(Source: Anime News Network)

100972.description:
Set in Kyoto, the manga tells the daily life of Kazuho Domoto, 25, and his two beautiful sisters, Nahoko (31) and Rihoko (28). The two women, despite being considered perfect, are completely disinterested in houseworks: it is Kazuho who takes care of everything.

(Source: Animeclick)

100973.description:
Misuzu Hara is a quiet, reserved 24-year-old high school teacher whose world is turned upside down after her friend’s fiancé rapes her. Her attempt to connect with one of her students, himself a victim of sexual trauma, results in an unlikely romance, and the repercussions of these events affect everyone around them in often unpredictable ways.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Notes: Nominated to the 22nd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

100982.description: A story of a young man who just adores his little sister... Maybe a little too much.

100984.description: Jebron is a country ruled by the Five Kings, who were born from the blood of a god. Sage, a young orphan, has a little sister named Hoshimi with the power of the gods, and in order to protect her, he decides to put his life in danger before the cruel and proud Blue King. However, he by chance encountered the Red King named Gules, kind and sympathetic, by which he begins to have feelings. But Sage is owned by the Blue King, and who feels insulted by the situation.

100985.description:
My girlfriend always brought her little sister everywhere, even on our dates. Now we're married, and she's still living with us! And that little girl is now a 21-year old beauty...God why have you given me this test?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

100986.description:
In this eccentric student council, it contains "the nothing but":
1. ...a face student council president Hiiragi Mikado
2. ...love vice president Yanase Kiri
3. ...money treasurer Kabashima Kyouichiro
4. ...brains treasurer Kashiwagi Sou
5. ...popular secretary Tsuge Chuukichi

With a student council like this, it's no wonder that the transfer student, Matsunami Yuki is overwhelmed and decides to win the chaotic marathon for her fellow new classmates (i.e. make new friends). Unfortunately (or fortunately?), she caught the eye of the "nothing but face student council president" himself! What will happen to her?

Note: Includes the one-shot "Shoujo Manga no Koi wa Shinai" (少女漫画の恋はしない.

Shoujo Manga no Koi wa Shinai

100988.description:
At first glance, the Fukuoka city seems like a peaceful one, but under the surface, crime is running rampant. The city's Hakata ward is home to the professionals of the underworld: professional killers, detectives, informants, professional revenge seekers, those skilled in torture, and more. And according to urban legend, even a "killer of professional killers" exists in the city. When stories of the men in the underworld are told, a "professional killer murder" appears.

(Source: Anime News Network)

100991.description:
Lights! Camera! ACTION! Kei Yonagi wants to be an actress! But an already-difficult dream to achieve has become much harder since her father left and her mother died. She's now taking care of her two little siblings on her own.

Without much money left, will she have to give up her dream?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)
synonyms: ดารายอดอัจฉริยะ

100992.description:
Technology leads to a continuous evolution of violence; this age of chaos gave birth to heroes.

In a not-too-distant future Japan, Akira, a high school student, has an uncertain future and begins to give up on his dream of studying robotics in college. Meanwhile, Tom Rock, CEO of the global robotics company Rock, Inc., is trying to put into place plans he's had in preparation for years. The fighter "Automaton" was developed to bring salvation to a world that has started to go crazy! The two of them meeting is the beginning of this story!

100993.description:
Kondou Youko has strangely pale eyes, just like her grandmother did before her. On her 17th birthday, she begins to see strange things that can't be seen by anyone around her. The first thing she sees is a child with a bandage over his eyes, who seems to be asking her for something. Is his situation merely tragic, or is his presence possibly dangerous for Youko?

Youko meets a college student, Tanonaka Kyouichi, who studies urban legends, folklore, and things of that nature. He believes her account of the strange child and helps her try to figure out what to do about him. After this first encounter that brings them together, Youko and Tanonaka begin to encounter all kinds of supernatural events together. With Youko's spiritual sight and Tanonaka's knowledge, they make an excellent team!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: おどろ 〜陽子と田ノ中の百鬼行事件簿〜
title.romaji: Odoro: Youko to Tanonaka no Hyakkikou Jikenbo

100994.description:
Gabimaru the Hollow is one of the most vicious assassins ever to come out of the ninja village of Iwagakure. He’s ruthlessly efficient, but a betrayal results in him being handed a death sentence. He has only one hope—in order to earn his freedom, he must travel to a long-hidden island and recover an elixir that will make the shogun immortal. Failure is not an option. On this island, heaven and hell are just a hair’s breadth away.

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: สุขาวดีอเวจี

100995.description:
What if Monogatari's Ararararagi, Zaregoto's Ii and Jun "Humanity's Strongest" Aikawa, and Okitegami Kyouko no Bibouroku's titular forgetful detective all attended school together? In 2002, NisiOisiN won a Mephisto Prize prize for his debut novel Zaregoto, Book 1: The Kubikiri Cycle. Part of the 15th anniversary celebration will be 4-panel crossover gag manga Seishun Kijin-den! 240 Gakuen (240 is a pronunciation pun - 240 can be read as "Nishio," so "Youth Oddball Story! Nisio Academy").

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Legend of Eccentric Youth! Nishio Academy

100996.description:
Two years ago, Akagi Kei's older brother Keiichi, who was a policeman with a bright future ahead of him, mysteriously vanished. The police eventually closed the case, but they never found any sign of what happened to her brother. After that, Kei was very busy as the oldest child in the house, especially since her mother worked nights, so it took her a while to recognize a strange new voice that was calling to her...

It was her brother, or at least her brother's skeletal ghost. Now she knows that her brother is dead, but she doesn't know how or why. He seems lost and confused, and says that he has come from a dark forest full of the dead that have a grudge against the living. For his part, as in life, he wants to help people and to protect his little sister Kei. Kei is just starting in a prestigious high school, where it seems that there is more than a fair share of supernatural darkness creeping into the student body. Kei and her brother use the skills of the living and the dead together to solve the mysteries behind her schoolmates' problems. Perhaps one day, Kei will also be able to solve the puzzle of her brother's death.

title.native: 兄妹 少女探偵と幽霊警官の怪奇事件簿
title.romaji: Kyoudai: Shoujo Tantei to Yuurei Keikan no Kaiki Jikenbo

100997.description:
When the news of the famous up-and-coming idol receiving a zero-point on his test and faking his college diploma is exposed, he is forced to go back to university and retake his classes. However, the person assigned to be his tutor actually turned out to be a broke country bumpkin! This is the story of two people from completely different backgrounds colliding and encountering unexpected events in everyday life which eventually turns into sparks of romance. Is it possible for there to be a happy ending between two people belonging to different worlds?

(Source: WebComics)

100998.description: High school student Xiao Xiang An is experiencing life in the big city for the first time while she is staying with her distant relatives. At the behest of her relative's friends, she ends up disguising herself and sneaking into a bar with them where she runs into a handsome and charming employee. The following day she goes back to her regular appearance only to have a very different encounter, meeting a guy who is nothing but rude and hateful!

100999.description:
Working retail is tough enough with regular human customers, but what about when they’re owls, wolves, koalas…and a woolly mammoth? Welcome to the Hokkyoku Department Store, where new employee Akino’s customers are talking animals–including extinct species! Just like any shopper, each has their own complicated request that Akino must strive to satisfy. From a wealthy laughing owl searching for the perfect present to delight his wife to a thespian sea mink attempting to find a gift for a long-awaited reunion with her father, Akino must learn to meet their needs, while also dealing with her challenging coworkers and elusive floor manager.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
